gallery.country_name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

text: You can tell the three German-speaking countries apart by **camera meta **alone:

- Austria only has **Generation 3** and Generation 4 coverage (the only exceptions being Generation 2 on [one road](https://goo.gl/maps/LebHyLrqsjkqyoZMA) in Burgenland, and several [ski resort trekkers](https://goo.gl/maps/pdquUsUJoNwZghxRA)).
- Germany only has Generation 4 coverage. (the only exceptions being spills and trekkers)
- Switzerland car coverage is always [low-cam](https://goo.gl/maps/Ey7aUdEn6vc76BZc8). This can be recognized by the much bigger car blur.
text_zh: 你光憑**相機線索特徵**就能區分這三個德語國家：
- 奧地利僅有 **第 3 代** 和第 4 代街景覆蓋（唯一的例外是布 Burgenland 的[某條道路](https://goo.gl/maps/LebHyLrqsjkqyoZMA)上有第 2 代，以及幾個[滑雪場徒步拍攝](https://goo.gl/maps/pdquUsUJoNwZghxRA)）。
- 德國只有 Generation 4 街景覆蓋。（唯一的例外是外溢畫面和徒步拍攝）
- 瑞士的汽車街景覆蓋永遠是[低鏡頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Ey7aUdEn6vc76BZc8)。這可以透過大得多的車輛模糊來識別。

text: Canada has a fair amount of **Generation 2 coverage**, especially in rural** **or remote areas. Generation 2 can be recognized by the big circular car blur and the halo-like colour distortion in the sky.
NOTE: Generation 2 is very rare in the US. If you are between Canada and the US, and the location is in Generation 2, you are much more likely to be in Canada.
text_zh: 加拿大有相當數量的**第 2 世代街景覆蓋**，特別是在鄉村** **或偏遠地區。第 2 世代的特徵是車底有大型圓形模糊，以及天空呈現光暈狀的色彩失真。
註：第 2 世代在美國非常罕見。如果你在加拿大與美國之間猶豫，而該地點屬於第 2 世代，那麼很有可能是在加拿大。

text: The Lugard Road trekker around Victoria Peak can be recognized by the distinct** black guardrail**, view of the skyline and tourists walking along the path.
text_zh: 太平山頂周邊的盧吉道徒步拍攝街景可以透過顯眼的**黑色護欄**、天際線景觀以及沿著小徑行走的遊客來辨識。

text: Generation 3 coverage in Kenya often features a **visible roof rack ** and a **snorkel**. Some Generation 3 coverage has [no visible car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UGBAo7hH2mhLsUv46).
text_zh: 肯亞的 Generation 3 街景通常帶有**明顯的車頂架**和**進氣 snorkel**。部分 Generation 3 街景則[看不到車子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UGBAo7hH2mhLsUv46)。

text: There will **never be an antenna **on the Google car.
Every other country in Europe will have an antenna sometimes in Generation 3 coverage. For clarity’s sake: this means that cars with no antenna can be found outside North Macedonia.
NOTE: The only other country to have no antenna the majority of the time is Serbia, although there will be an antenna sometimes.
text_zh: Google 車上**絕不會有天線**。
歐洲的其他每個國家在相機世代 3 的街景覆蓋中偶爾都會有天線。為了釐清起見：這意味著沒有天線的車輛可以在北馬其頓境外找到。
備註：大多數時候沒有天線的唯一其他國家是塞爾維亞，儘管偶爾還是會有天線。

text: In GENERATION 3 coverage A** green truck** is visible behind the Google Car for a portion of the E-65. The truck is visible from Kichevo to Arbinovo.
NOTE: This hint is mostly obsolete
text_zh: 在相機世代 3 的街景覆蓋中，E-65 的其中一段路程中，Google 車後方可以看到一台**綠色卡車**。從基切沃（Kichevo）到阿爾比諾沃（Arbinovo）都可以看到這台卡車。
備註：這個提示大多已經過時

text: All the coverage in Rwanda is made with a Generation 4 camera. In most of the coverage, the Google car is a pickup truck which will be covered entirely by a **big blur**.
text_zh: 盧安達所有的街景覆蓋都是用第四代相機拍攝的。在大多數的覆蓋中，Google 車是一輛皮卡車，其車身會完全被一個**大模糊塊**遮蓋住。

text: Sometimes the Google car is entirely visible: it is a big **white **or **brown pickup truck** with a brakelight. The camera mount is visible.
text_zh: 有時可以看到整台 Google 車：是一輛帶有煞車燈的大型**白色**或**棕色皮卡車**。相機支架清晰可見。

text: The Akagera national park features a very **vegetated **yet **dry **landscape with wide unpaved roads that are reddish-brown in colour.

You can also find these rectangular [waystones](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.9022489,30.722706,2a,20y,181.31h,78.8t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fw%3D900%26h%3D600%26panoid%3DB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.share%26yaw%3D182.35496720275722%26pitch%3D10.959278061715409%26thumbfov%3D18!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu) at intersections.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.

NOTE: There is some coverage on the [paved section](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.8994956,30.6816537,2a,75y,17.57h,83.7t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D25.209553%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu) south of the national park.
text_zh: 阿卡蓋拉國家公園（Akagera National Park）的地貌非常**植被茂密**卻又**乾燥**，並有著紅褐色的寬闊未鋪裝道路。

你也可以在交叉路口找到這些長方形的[里程碑](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.9022489,30.722706,2a,20y,181.31h,78.8t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fw%3D900%26h%3D600%26panoid%3DB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.share%26yaw%3D182.35496720275722%26pitch%3D10.959278061715409%26thumbfov%3D18!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

注意：國家公園南方的一段[鋪裝路段](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.8994956,30.6816537,2a,75y,17.57h,83.7t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D25.209553%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)也有覆蓋。

text: The Nyungwe Forest National Park goes through a **lush** and **hilly **landscape, which has 2 distinct covered roads; The yellow NR10 is paved, with roadlines. **French style bollards** and** green lamp posts** can be seen on the sides of the road. The[ white NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) going south is mostly paved, except for the [southernmost section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6). No roadlines are present.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.
text_zh: 紐恩威森林國家公園（Nyungwe Forest National Park）穿過一片**蒼翠**且**丘陵起伏**的地貌，這裡有 2 條不同的覆蓋道路：黃色的 NR10 是柏油路，有道路標線。道路兩側可以看到**法式路樁**與**綠色路燈**。往南的[白色 NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) 大部分是柏油路，除了[最南端路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6)外。沒有道路標線。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

text: Most of the generation 3 coverage in Serbia was taken by a Google car with **no antenna**.
NOTE: Other than North Macedonia, almost all of central and eastern Europe has antenna coverage in Generation 3.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞大部分的第 3 代街景覆蓋是由一台**沒有天線**的 Google 車所拍攝的。
注意：除了北馬其頓之外，幾乎整個中歐和東歐的第 3 代街景都有天線。

text: A white Google Car with a **short antenna** can be seen in Novi Sad, Kovilj, in and around Belgrade, Niš, and the E75 connecting them.
NOTE: The white car is not always visible.
text_zh: 在諾維薩德、科維利（Kovilj）、貝爾格勒市區及周邊、尼什，以及連接它們的 E75 高速公路上，可以看到一台帶有**短天線**的白色 Google 車。
註：白色轎車不一定隨時看得到。

text: Prudhoe Bay, the northernmost town in America covered by street view, can be recognized by **cold, dead** landscape, overcast clouds and lack of tall buildings. A second Google car can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 普魯德霍灣 (Prudhoe Bay) 是美國最北端有街景覆蓋的城鎮，可以透過其**寒冷、荒蕪**的景觀、陰沉的天空以及缺乏高樓大廈來辨識。有時可以看到第二輛 Google 車。

text: [Nome](https://goo.gl/maps/efqLHvNVtEK2fGPNA), [Unalakleet](https://goo.gl/maps/1DYUKxvbEs7sR17v5) and [Galena](https://goo.gl/maps/aX2axEUDjqNexfiR6) are three isolated Alaskan towns which are covered only by trekker. The trekker’s **lime green hat** or [black and white beanie](https://goo.gl/maps/V28pqftM9fbJ8Qwo6) can be seen.
NOTE: The trekker’s black and white bandana can only be seen in Nome.
text_zh: [諾姆](https://goo.gl/maps/efqLHvNVtEK2fGPNA)、[烏納拉克利特](https://goo.gl/maps/1DYUKxvbEs7sR17v5) 和 [加利納](https://goo.gl/maps/aX2axEUDjqNexfiR6) 是阿拉斯加三個偏遠城鎮，僅由徒步拍攝 (trekker) 覆蓋。可以看到徒步拍攝者 (trekker) 的**螢光綠帽子**或 [黑白毛帽](https://goo.gl/maps/V28pqftM9fbJ8Qwo6)。
注意：徒步拍攝者 (trekker) 的黑白頭巾只能在諾姆看到。

text: There are two types of car and camera meta in generation 3 Albania:
- Coverage where the Google car has a long antenna and you can see rifts in the sky.
- Coverage where the Google car has a short antenna and there are no rifts visible.

_You can click on the image to enlarge it. You can also use [this Maps layer](https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/0/viewer?ll=41.11823444009704%2C20.361213161801423&mid=1y5ixAA3bq5FNQrDNfpzSF5Hv80K-BkM&z=8) to look at the coverage in more detail (credits to icraig1205)._
text_zh: 第三代 (gen 3) 阿爾巴尼亞街景中，有兩種 Google 車和相機的 線索特徵 (meta)：
- 街景覆蓋是 Google 車有長天線，且天空有接圖裂縫。
- 街景覆蓋是 Google 車有短天線，且看不到接圖裂縫。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。你也可以使用 [這個地圖圖層](https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/0/viewer?ll=41.11823444009704%2C20.361213161801423&mid=1y5ixAA3bq5FNQrDNfpzSF5Hv80K-BkM&z=8) 來查看更詳細的街景覆蓋範圍（感謝 icraig1205）。_

text: Ofu Airport is small with a **concrete** runway. The Google Car covering it has two **orange straps** on the roof. Many palm trees can also be seen on the other side of the runway.
text_zh: Ofu機場是個小型機場，跑道是**混凝土**的。拍攝該機場的Google 車車頂有兩條**橘色綁帶**。跑道另一側也能看到許多棕櫚樹。

text: Andorra **only has Generation 2 and Generation 3** coverage. In all Generation 3 coverage, a medium-short antenna is visible on the Google car.
Generation 3 is by far the most common. Almost all of Generation 2 is overwritten and is mostly confined to a couple of smaller off-roads.
text_zh: 安道爾**只有第二代和第三代**街景覆蓋。在所有第三代街景覆蓋中，Google 車上可看到一根中短天線。
第三代街景是迄今為止最常見的。幾乎所有第二代街景都已被覆蓋，主要局限於一些較小的非鋪裝道路。

text: The trekker can be seen **walking in a line **on Deception Island.
text_zh: 在欺騙島上，可以看到徒步拍攝者**排成一列行走**。

text: Southeast of McMurdo station, the trekker can be seen walking on a layer of ice around **various machinery**.
text_zh: 在麥克默多站的東南方，可以看到徒步拍攝者在冰層上，繞著 **各式機械** 行走。

text: The trekker can be seen walking through a fantastical landscape consisting of many **desolate valleys** on mainland Antarctica, west of Ross Island.
text_zh: 在羅斯島以西的南極大陸上，可以看到徒步拍攝者穿梭於由許多 **荒涼山谷** 組成的奇幻景觀中。

text: Argentina has a **black** Google car in Generation 3 coverage.
NOTE: Within South America, only Argentina, Peru and Uruguay have a black Google car.
text_zh: 阿根廷在第三代街景覆蓋中，有**黑色**的 Google 車。
注意：在南美洲，只有阿根廷、秘魯和烏拉圭有黑色 Google 車。

text: This **horse trekker** can be found in southwestern San Juan.
NOTE: A similar trekker can be found on the other side in Chile.
text_zh: 這種**徒步拍攝馬匹**可見於聖胡安省西南部。
注意：智利另一側也有類似的徒步拍攝。

text: Australia is home to dozens of **rare Google cars**, which can usually be found in natural reserves.

Most rare Google cars with **snorkels **are located in New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. The [snorkels](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_snorkel) are dark grey or black extensions to the side of the car, to keep the engine dry when submerged in water.
NOTE: The only snorkels outside NSW and ACT are found on two cars in Western Australia ([1](https://goo.gl/maps/wFgk2iGZBaQLe2nN8) and [2](https://goo.gl/maps/Em5BHeArvFHzkiJ29)).
_GeoHints has a complete overview of all rare cars, which can be found on [this page](https://geohints.com/meta/googleVehicles/cars)._
text_zh: 澳洲擁有數十輛**稀有 Google 車**，通常可以在自然保護區找到。
大多數裝有**涉水管 **的稀有 Google 車都位於新南威爾斯州和澳洲首都領地。[涉水管](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_snorkel)是車側深灰色或黑色的延伸管，用於在車輛涉水時保持引擎乾燥。
註：新南威爾斯州和澳洲首都領地之外唯一裝有涉水管的，是西澳的兩輛車（[1](https://goo.gl/maps/wFgk2iGZBaQLe2nN8) 和 [2](https://goo.gl/maps/Em5BHeArvFHzkiJ29)）。
_GeoHints 在[這個頁面](https://geohints.com/meta/googleVehicles/cars)提供了所有稀有車輛的完整總覽。_

text: A trekker going along the edge of a crater can be seen on Ilha do Faial.
text_zh: 在法亞爾島上可以看到沿著火山口邊緣拍攝的徒步拍攝。

text: In the city of Barishal there can also be a **guard** at the side of the car visible, not to be confused with the Sylhet guard.
NOTE: The [same man](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZRAD485rKUBixpPU8) can rarely be found elsewhere on trekker coverage.
text_zh: 在 Barishal 市，車旁也可以看到一名**警衛**，不要與 Sylhet 的警衛混淆。
備註：極少數情況下可以在其他地方的徒步拍攝街景覆蓋中看到[同一個人](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZRAD485rKUBixpPU8)。

text: This interesting trekker with a black cover can be found in the city of **Khulna**.
text_zh: 這個有趣的黑色外罩徒步拍攝可以在 **庫爾納** 市找到。

text: The trekker with **red colour** in the mirrors is unique to the island of Nijhum Dwip.
text_zh: 後視鏡呈現**紅色**的徒步拍攝設備是 Nijhum Dwip 島所獨有的。

text: A scooter trekker, where mostly the **left mirror** and some **hair** is visible, can be found on Hatiya Island.
text_zh: 在 Hatiya 島上可以看到主要能看到**左後視鏡**和一些**頭髮**的速克達徒步拍攝設備。

text: A trekker escorted by a **security guard** is found on Saint Martin's Island.
text_zh: 由**安全警衛**護送的徒步拍攝設備可在 Saint Martin's 島上找到。

text: The only coverage in Belarus, apart from spills, is a single **walking trekker** in the historic centre of Minsk.
Instead of learning a lot of country-specific clues, it is more practical to simply memorise what the trekker looks like.
You can recognise trekkers by the fact that the camera feels a bit lower than the usual Google car. In Belarus’ case, the trekker is also mostly on pedestrian-only roads.
_You can find information about the border spill coverage in the [Spillover Guide](/spillover-countries)._
text_zh: 白俄羅斯除了跨境溢出之外，唯一的街景覆蓋是位於明斯克（Minsk）歷史中心的單一**徒步拍攝**。
與其學習大量特定國家的線索，不如直接記住徒步拍攝設備的外觀更為實用。
您可以透過相機感覺比一般的 Google 車稍微低一些來辨識徒步拍攝。以白俄羅斯為例，徒步拍攝也多半位於行人專用道上。
_您可以在 [Spillover 指南](/spillover-countries) 中找到有關邊境溢出街景覆蓋的資訊。_

text: The Minsk trekker features a **historic part of the city**, with well-maintained classical European architecture. Many buildings have white or pastel coloured walls. Most of the roads you see are pedestrian-only.
text_zh: 明斯克的徒步拍攝展示了**該市的歷史區域**，擁有維護良好的古典歐洲建築。許多建築都有白色或粉彩色的外牆。您看到的大多數道路都是行人專用道。

text: The pavement which the trekker walks on in Minsk is mostly **grey rectangular tiles**. On a small part, there are [pink-ish tiles](https://goo.gl/maps/jBJvXJYu2yqYENLw9) in a specific pattern.
text_zh: 徒步拍攝者在明斯克走的人行道大多是**灰色矩形地磚**。在小部分區域有呈特定圖案的[粉紅色系地磚](https://goo.gl/maps/jBJvXJYu2yqYENLw9)。

text: A **boat trekker** can be seen on the eastern coast of Bermuda. It can be seen going around [Saint George’s Harbour](https://goo.gl/maps/U6Lze1J5ehU1tJqr9) and past [Fort St. Catherine](https://goo.gl/maps/9UciXRzs9WeyiRpv6) on the northeast tip of the island.
text_zh: 在百慕達東岸可以看到**船隻徒步拍攝**。可以看到它環繞[聖喬治港](https://goo.gl/maps/U6Lze1J5ehU1tJqr9)，並穿過島嶼東北端的[聖凱瑟琳堡](https://goo.gl/maps/9UciXRzs9WeyiRpv6)。

text: Coverage in Bhutan was taken by a **grey** Google car without an antenna.
NOTE: Bhutan is the only left hand driving country which has a grey Google car. Make sure to not mix it up with a white Google car, since they can look similar.
text_zh: 不丹的街景覆蓋是由一輛沒有天線的**灰色** Google 車拍攝的。
注意：不丹是唯一擁有灰色 Google 車的靠左駕駛國家。請確保不要將其與白色 Google 車混淆，因為它們看起來很像。

text: A **hook** can be seen on the back of the car in Haa District, mainly in the town of Ha.
NOTE: The hook is sometimes just [barely visible](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sjuWHQTbSpkjC6wAA) due to the car blur.
text_zh: 在哈阿宗（Haa District），主要是在哈阿鎮（Ha），可以看到 Google 車後方有一個**鉤子**。
注意：由於車輛模糊，這個鉤子有時[僅勉強可見](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sjuWHQTbSpkjC6wAA)。

text: Bolivia only has Generation 3 camera coverage. All of the country was covered by a solid **white Google car with no antenna**.
NOTE: In Latin America, white cars with no antenna can also be found in Peru and Chile.
text_zh: 玻利維亞只有第 3 代相機街景覆蓋。該國全境都是由一輛純**無天線白色 Google 車**拍攝的。
注意：在拉丁美洲，秘魯和智利也能找到無天線的白色 Google 車。

text: On the southwesternmost section of Ruta 4, you can usually see the **Nevado Sajama**, an isolated snow-capped volcano that is very distinct and unlike any other mountain in Bolivia.
When you see Sajama, you will always be south of Callapa and the Desaguadero River. However, you will not always be able to see it on this section of the road, as it is often hidden by hills.
NOTE: The only other place where you can see Nevado Sajama is coverage in the National Park, which is recognizable by its unique Google car.
text_zh: 在 Ruta 4 最西南端的路段上，你通常可以看到**薩哈馬火山**（Nevado Sajama），這是一座孤立的雪山火山，非常獨特且與玻利維亞的任何其他山脈都不同。
當你看見薩哈馬火山時，你一定位於 Callapa 和德薩瓜德羅河以南。然而，你在這段道路上並不總能看到它，因為它經常被丘陵遮擋。
註：唯一能看到薩哈馬火山的其他地方是國家公園內的街景覆蓋，該處可透過其獨特的 Google 車來辨識。

text: Between the villages of Villa Vitalina and Coipasa, there is an isolated stretch of coverage where the Google car drove through **extremely arid** desert terrain. This small road is located close to the southwestern end of Ruta 12, near the Chilean border. It can be hard to spot on the map, because it blends in with the salt flat.

Closer to Villa Vitalina, the car drove over the [salt flat](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9). Closer to Coipasa, the car drove on an unpaved dirt road, where you can see [cone-shaped volcanic hills](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7). In both parts, there is virtually no vegetation.
text_zh: 在 Villa Vitalina 和 Coipasa 村莊之間，有一段孤立的街景覆蓋，Google 車駛過了**極度乾旱的**沙漠地形。這條小路位於 Ruta 12 的西南端附近，靠近智利邊境。在地圖上可能很難注意到，因為它與鹽沼融為一體。
靠近 Villa Vitalina 時，車輛駛過了[鹽沼](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9)。靠近 Coipasa 時，車輛行駛在未鋪設路面的泥土路上，在那裡你可以看到[錐形的火山丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7)。這兩個部分幾乎都沒有植被。

text: **Sajama National Park** was covered by this unique Google car: it has a black roof rack with a series of metal bars.

The coverage is on an unpaved road surrounded by fluffy bushes. The Nevado Sajama volcano is always [visible](https://goo.gl/maps/31GHyyrBPvTCCVtF7). The car briefly drove through the small village of [Tomarapi](https://goo.gl/maps/9V7ug4DXpnJbr6CW6), which can be recognized by its traditional buildings with adobe walls and thatched roofs.
text_zh: **薩哈馬國家公園**是由這輛獨特的 Google 車拍攝的：它有一個帶有一系列金屬桿的黑色車頂架。
街景位於一條周圍環繞著蓬鬆灌木叢的未鋪柏油道路上。薩哈馬火山始終[清晰可見](https://goo.gl/maps/31GHyyrBPvTCCVtF7)。Google 車曾短暫駛過小村莊[托馬拉皮](https://goo.gl/maps/9V7ug4DXpnJbr6CW6)，該村莊以其擁有adobe泥磚牆和茅草屋頂的傳統建築而聞名。

text: All of Botswana was covered by a **white** Google car without an antenna.
NOTE: Within Africa, this car can also be found in South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini.
text_zh: 波札那全境均由一輛沒有天線的**白色** Google 車所拍攝覆蓋。
註：在非洲境內，這款車也可以在南非、賴索托和史瓦帝尼看到。

text: This **Amazonian trekker** combines [boat](https://goo.gl/maps/oUDek9JNat9NFZAt6) and walking coverage on and near the Madeira and Aripuana rivers, south of the 319. They are seen travelling through dense rainforest and small villages.
text_zh: 這項**亞馬遜徒步拍攝**結合了 319 號公路以南的馬代拉河與阿里普阿南河及其附近的[乘船](https://goo.gl/maps/oUDek9JNat9NFZAt6)與步行覆蓋。可以看到拍攝者穿梭於茂密的雨林和小村莊之間。

text: The beautiful National Park of Northeast Maranhão, known for its **sand dunes** with pools of water, has [walking trekker](https://goo.gl/maps/Pftf1x4EiqezRmw38) and [vehicle coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/atT5yDswGMP8jaWs9). The truck is white with a black bed. The landscape can vary from beach to sandy wetland.
text_zh: 馬拉尼昂州東北部美麗的國家公園以帶有水池的**沙丘**聞名，那裡有[徒步拍攝](https://goo.gl/maps/Pftf1x4EiqezRmw38)和[車輛拍攝覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/atT5yDswGMP8jaWs9)。貨車是白色的，帶有黑色車斗。景觀可以從海灘變化到沙質濕地。

text: Coverage was taken with a Generation 3 **trekker**.
text_zh: 街景覆蓋是用 3 代**徒步拍攝**進行採集的。

text: The trekker can occasionally be found walking offshore in the water.
text_zh: 偶爾可以看到徒步拍攝者走在近岸的水中。

text: On the Generation 3 coverage you can find two different Google cars:
- A car with a short, stubby antenna. The antenna has **three ridges**. It can sometimes be hard to tell if the antenna has ridges.

- A white car with **stripes** and no antenna. There is a white stripe on the left, and a yellow stripe on the right. The stripes are sometimes [poorly visible](https://goo.gl/maps/4vGAo6xju653jkXQ9).
The car is not always as visible as shown in the example images.
NOTE: This specific striped white car is unique to Cambodia. Make sure not to mix it up with the [Bangladeshi striped car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jUkCUxjEsT75EzWf6), which looks slightly different.
The Latin American countries of Mexico, Colombia, Ecuador and Brazil also have cars with similar short antennas. However, these have a diagonally coiled ridge, instead of Cambodia’s three ridges.
text_zh: 在 Generation 3 的街景覆蓋中，你可以看到兩種不同的 Google 車：
- 一款配有短胖天線的車。天線上有**三個凸起**。有時很難看出天線是否有凸起。
- 一款**帶有條紋**且沒有天線的白色車。左側有一條白色條紋，右側有一條黃色條紋。這些條紋有時[不太明顯](https://goo.gl/maps/4vGAo6xju653jkXQ9)。
車子不一定每次都像範例圖片中那樣清晰可見。
注意：這款特定的條紋白色車是柬埔寨獨有的。請注意不要將它與外觀略有不同的[孟加拉條紋車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jUkCUxjEsT75EzWf6)混淆。
拉丁美洲國家如墨西哥、哥倫比亞、厄瓜多和巴西也有配備類似短天線的車。不過，這些天線帶有對角螺旋狀的凸起，而不是柬埔寨的三個凸起。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Cambodia. This camera is known as the official Ari (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Within Asia, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Nepal also have shitcam coverage.
text_zh: Google 在柬埔寨使用了一款奇怪且低品質的相機。這台相機被社群稱為官方 Ari（或「Shitcam」）。它有寬大的圓形車輛模糊，顏色通常有些偏棕色。優質的地圖通常不會包含這種街景覆蓋，但最好了解它的存在，以免被打得猝不及防。
注意：在亞洲，印度、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡和尼泊爾也有 shitcam 街景覆蓋。

text: **Angkor Wat** is a massive temple complex built by the historical Khmer Empire. It is located just north of Siem Reap and has extensive trekker coverage. It can be recognized by its dark, weathered stone buildings. While this location is unlikely to show up in competitive maps, it is extremely common in GeoGuessr’s official Cambodia map.
text_zh: **吳哥窟（Angkor Wat）**是由歷史上的高棉帝國建造的巨大寺廟群。它位於 Siem Reap 正北方，擁有廣泛的徒步拍攝（trekker）街景覆蓋。它可以透過深色、風化的石造建築來辨認。雖然這個地點不太可能出現在競技地圖中，但在 GeoGuessr 的官方柬埔寨地圖中非常常見。

text: A group of **motorcyclists **can be seen in front of the Google car on this stretch of Highway 1 near Beaver Creek in Yukon.
text_zh: 在育空海狸溪附近的 1 號公路這段路上記錄到，Google 車前方有一群**摩托車騎士**。

text: The remote town of Churchill in northern Manitoba features a trekker with a distinct thin **antenna **visible on the front right side of the car. The town also has unique street signs.
NOTE: This coverage is also seen in the surrounding area.
text_zh: 曼尼托巴省北部的偏遠小鎮邱吉爾（Churchill）具有徒步拍攝街景，其車頭右前方明顯可見一根細長的**天線**。該鎮也擁有獨特的街道標誌。
注意：周遭地區也能看到這種街景覆蓋。

text: This unique Google car and **dark**-coloured soil is found in Tulita, NWT. The car will most often look like this, but can also be fully blurred with just the **antenna** visible, or with the hood of the car visible.
text_zh: 西北地區（NWT）的圖利塔（Tulita）可以找到這種獨特的 Google 車和**深**色土壤。這台車多數時候看起來會是這樣，但也可能完全被模糊處理只看得見**天線**，或者看得到車頭蓋。

text: Sanikiluaq is a remote town situated **in Hudson Bay**. This snowy town was covered by a snowmobile whose driver wore a dark **brown **coat.
NOTE: Snowmobile coverage can be found [outside](https://goo.gl/maps/7xhV916CkhjwrEhU8) the town on the ice-covered sea, where the driver is **not **visible.
text_zh: 薩尼基盧阿克（Sanikiluaq）是位於**哈德遜灣**（Hudson Bay）中的偏遠城鎮。這個雪景城鎮是由一台雪上摩托車拍攝的，駕駛穿著深**棕**色外套。
注意：在冰封的海面上，也就是城鎮[外圍](https://goo.gl/maps/7xhV916CkhjwrEhU8)，可以找到雪上摩托車街景，在那裡**看不到**駕駛。

text: Inukjuak is a town in northern Québec. This town can be recognized by the **snowmobile **that is** **visible through the blur.
NOTE: In Sanikiluaq, the other town with snowmobile coverage, you will always see the driver.
text_zh: 因庫朱阿克（Inukjuak）是魁北克北部的一個城鎮。這個城鎮可以透過在模糊處理中隱約**可見**的**雪上摩托車**來辨識。
注意：在薩尼基盧阿克這個另一個擁有雪上摩托車街景的城鎮，你總是會看到駕駛。

text: Cambridge Bay is the only Nunavut settlement to have **Generation 2** trekker coverage.
text_zh: 劍橋灣是努納武特地區唯一擁有**第 2 世代**徒步拍攝街景覆蓋的聚落。

text: Nain is a small town on the Northeastern coast of Labrador. The town features **colourful wooden houses**, and **trees **in and around the town. To the north, a [big hill](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7) is usually visible. And to the south, [rocky cliffs](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6) can be seen on the other side of the bay. Additionally, kids can sometimes be seen walking beside the trekker.
text_zh: 內恩（Nain）是拉布拉多東北海岸的小鎮。該鎮的特色是**色彩繽紛的木屋**，且鎮內及周邊有**樹木**。朝北通常可以看到[大山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7)。朝南則可以在海灣對岸看到[岩石峭壁](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6)。此外，有時候可以看到小孩走在跟拍車旁邊。

text: The **northernmost Google Street View coverage in the world** is a trekker on Ellesmere Island in northern Nunavut. It shows a glacier in a rocky, desolate landscape that is devoid of any vegetation.

NOTE: This coverage is sometimes used in maps to improve and standardise the scoring range. As a result, you might encounter this trekker in competitive maps like ACW, despite it not being pinpointable.
text_zh: **全世界最北的 Google 街景覆蓋**是位於努納福特北部埃爾斯米爾島（Ellesmere Island）上的徒步拍攝街景。它展示了荒涼岩石景觀中的冰川，該處完全沒有任何植被。
注意：這種街景有時會被地圖拿來改善並標準化評分範圍。因此，儘管它無法精確定位，你還是可能會在 ACW 等競技地圖中遇到這個徒步拍攝街景。

text: Chile has a solid **white** Google Car with no antenna in **Generation 3**. There are two variants:
- [A plain white car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1nNGSJYhdk9Th3c9A) (left).
- [A white car with a visible black section](https://goo.gl/maps/sk6weUxKpaC7pAvz7) (right). This car is unique to Chile.
A blue Google Car can be seen in Generation 4.
NOTE: In Generation 3, a plain white Google Car with no antenna can also be seen in Peru and Bolivia.
text_zh: 智利有一台無天線的純**白色** Google 車，屬於**第三代相機**。有兩種款式：
- [一台素色白車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1nNGSJYhdk9Th3c9A)（左）。
- [一台帶有明顯黑色部分的白車](https://goo.gl/maps/sk6weUxKpaC7pAvz7)（右）。這台車是智利特有的。
第四代相機可以看到藍色 Google 車。
注意：在第三代相機中，秘魯和玻利維亞也能看到無天線的純白色 Google 車。

text: In the west, Nevado Tres Cruces National Park can be recognized by the vast, open landscape, followed by **salt pans** leading up to a line of mountains. The sand has a **reddish **tint.
In the east, the Google Car drives up a mountain pass with views of lightly snow-capped volcanoes and **snow **on the side of the road. The roads in the National Park are paved.
text_zh: 在西部，內瓦多特雷斯克魯塞斯國家公園（Nevado Tres Cruces National Park）可以透過廣闊開闊的景觀來辨認，接著是通往一排山脈的**鹽灘**。沙子帶有**紅色**調。
在東部，Google 車行駛在一個山隘上，可以看到微帶積雪的火山以及路邊的**雪**。國家公園內的道路都是鋪裝道路。

text: The Google car can be seen towing a **white and silver trailer** with the word ‘Outback’ south of the Chilean National Zoo in Santiago.
text_zh: Google 車在聖地牙哥的智利國家動物園以南，拖著一台帶有「Outback」字樣的**白銀相間拖車**。

text: A **grey** Toyota Hilux, with various gear loaded and a **snorkel** on the front right, can be seen from around Baños Morales to [this point](https://goo.gl/maps/SWHeb1yv3ppVSbBTA), where the trekker continues the journey on foot.
text_zh: 一台載有各種裝備且右前側裝有**呼吸管**的**灰色** Toyota Hilux，可以從巴尼奧斯莫拉萊斯 (Baños Morales) 一帶一直看到[這個點](https://goo.gl/maps/SWHeb1yv3ppVSbBTA)，在那裡徒步拍攝改以步行繼續旅程。

text: This **horse trekker** can be seen to the northeast of San Felipe.
NOTE: A similar trekker can be found on the other side of the border in Argentina.
text_zh: 這個**騎馬徒步拍攝**可以在聖費利佩 (San Felipe) 東北方看到。
註：相似的徒步拍攝可以在國界另一側的阿根廷找到。

text: The Torres del Paine area can be recognized by the **sharp peaked** mountains, and the trekker walking on a **glacier** along with other people in orange helmets.
text_zh: 百內國家公園地區可以透過**尖峭峰頂**的山脈，以及在**冰川**上行走、身穿橘色頭盔的其他人來識別。

text: All official coverage in mainland China is taken with a **tripod**. Objects in the image will usually have motion blur, and slightly saturated colours.
NOTE: Hong Kong and Macau both have full Google Car coverage.
_A separate Plonk It guide to Hong Kong can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/hong-kong). The Macau guide can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/macau)._
text_zh: 中國大陸的所有官方覆蓋都是用**三腳架**拍攝的。影像中的物件通常會有動態模糊，且色彩稍微過飽和。
NOTE: 香港與澳門皆有完整的 Google 車覆蓋。
_一份獨立的 Plonk It 香港指南可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/hong-kong)找到。澳門指南可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/macau)找到。_

text: Christmas Island has two types of coverage: car coverage and a couple of trekkers.
The car coverage was done with a unique Google car: a **silver pickup truck**, with the bed of the truck visible. Usually, this is all you need to identify Christmas Island.
text_zh: 聖誕島有兩種型態的覆蓋：汽車覆蓋以及幾個徒步拍攝。
汽車覆蓋是由一台獨特的 Google 車完成的：一台**銀色皮卡車**，車斗清晰可見。通常，這就是識別聖誕島所需的全部資訊。

text: While much of the coverage is on regular roads, the Google car also drove on some very **rural trails**.
text_zh: 雖然大部分覆蓋都在一般道路上，但 Google 車也行駛在一些非常**鄉村的小徑**上。

text: There is a **boat trekker** near the north coast of the island. Some of the boat’s white-coloured deck pokes through the blur. Much of the trekker closely hugs the coast; here you can see the steep, rocky coastline of Christmas Island.
text_zh: 島嶼北海岸附近有一個**船隻徒步拍攝**。該艘船白色的甲板有部分從模糊中穿透出來。該徒步拍攝大多緊貼著海岸；在這裡你可以看到聖誕島陡峭、岩石密布的海岸線。

text: An exception to the road coverage mostly having car meta is the coastal **Jln Pantai road**, where a regular trekker was used. On this road, you will not see the back of the car, just a trekker blur.
text_zh: 道路覆蓋大多擁有汽車特徵的一個例外是沿海的 **Jln Pantai 道路**，那裡使用的是一般的徒步拍攝。在這條路上，你不會看到車尾，只有徒步拍攝的模糊影像。

text: This **golf course trekker** is on the northeast coast. In some places, the Google car also drove on this golf course.
text_zh: 這個**高爾夫球場徒步拍攝**位於東北海岸。在某些地方，Google 車也曾開進這個高爾夫球場。

text: Christmas Island is famous for its **red crabs**. Near Ethel Beach, you can find a trekker walking among hundreds of these crabs. Another smaller trekker where you can see crabs is [near The Dales](https://goo.gl/maps/deYXgd8DDC3RfBbd6), on the West Coast. Throughout the island, you can find [references](https://goo.gl/maps/jhXdg6Yp6Yo9LpMA9) on signs to these crabs.
text_zh: 聖誕島以其**紅蟹**聞名。在埃特爾海灘（Ethel Beach）附近，你可以找到一個徒步拍攝走在數百隻這些螃蟹之中。另一個可以看到螃蟹較小的徒步拍攝位於西海岸的[戴爾斯（The Dales）附近](https://goo.gl/maps/deYXgd8DDC3RfBbd6)。在全島各處，你都可以在標誌上找到對這些螃蟹的[參考提及](https://goo.gl/maps/jhXdg6Yp6Yo9LpMA9)。

text: Direction Island can be recognized by the beaches having significantly more **litter** compared to the other islands. [Bricks](https://goo.gl/maps/tSjoPrWjNQyRNRig7), [styrofoam](https://goo.gl/maps/Yvcoa9whDkWhEQDT7) and [dead coral](https://goo.gl/maps/3jQPVmeJT2PCunwY9) can be seen along some portions of the coast.
In addition, the trekker can be seen walking between many palms [inland](https://goo.gl/maps/63zUyWmqRJoKygM38).
text_zh: 方向島（Direction Island）可以透過海灘與其他島嶼相比有顯著較多的**垃圾**來識別。沿著海岸的一些部分可以看到[磚塊](https://goo.gl/maps/tSjoPrWjNQyRNRig7)、[保麗龍](https://goo.gl/maps/Yvcoa9whDkWhEQDT7)與[死珊瑚](https://goo.gl/maps/3jQPVmeJT2PCunwY9)。
此外，可以看到徒步拍攝在[內陸](https://goo.gl/maps/63zUyWmqRJoKygM38)的許多棕櫚樹之間行走。

text: The inland trekker on Pulau Luar (Horsburgh Island) can be recognized by the **dry**, yellow grass, and more **sparse** vegetation.
text_zh: 盧阿爾島（Pulau Luar，即霍斯堡島 Horsburgh Island）的內陸徒步拍攝可以透過**乾燥**的黃草以及更**稀疏**的植被來識別。

text: In Generation 3 coverage, a **short thick antenna** is sometimes visible with a black, white or grey car. In Generation 4 coverage, a white or silver car is commonly found.
NOTE: Within the Americas, you can also find the antenna in Mexico, Ecuador and Brazil. However, Colombia is the only country with this antenna on a black Google car.
text_zh: 在第 3 代街景覆蓋中，搭配黑色、白色或灰色汽車時，有時可以看到一個**短而粗的天線**。在第 4 代覆蓋中，通常會找到白色或銀色的汽車。
註：在美洲內，你也可以在墨西哥、厄瓜多與巴西找到該天線。然而，哥倫比亞是唯一在黑色 Google 車上擁有此天線的國家。

text: Southwest of La Fortuna, near the Fortuna Waterfall, you’ll find a Generation 4 trekker taken by Rainbolt on a downhill trail with many stair segments. It concludes at a [waterfall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NTT52QT14FChn7Cc9). You can recognise it from his **brown hair** or the **camera crew** following him.
West of La Fortuna, in the Puentes Colgantes Arenal, Mistico Park, there is another trekker on a** tropical trail**, taken by a **black-haired** individual.
text_zh: 在拉福圖納西南方、福圖納瀑布附近，你會找到由 Rainbolt 在一條有許多階梯的下坡步道上拍攝的第 4 代相機世代徒步拍攝。它結束於一個[瀑布](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NTT52QT14FChn7Cc9)。你可以透過他的**棕色頭髮**或跟隨他的**攝影團隊**來認出它。
在拉福圖納西方、阿雷納爾懸索橋米斯蒂科公園（Puentes Colgantes Arenal, Mistico Park）內，還有另一個由**黑髮**人士在**熱帶步道**上拍攝的徒步拍攝。

text: Generation 3 coverage in Costa Rica is **very limited**, consisting of numerous trekkers in and around San José and by the northern west coast. There is also coverage on [Cocos Island](https://goo.gl/maps/RUkuKe4mafK2gbss9), located 500 kilometres southwest of the coast, as well as a boat trekker around [Caño Island](https://goo.gl/maps/CabJDTQ4Cox9ycSQ6) by the southern west coast.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加的第 3 代相機世代覆蓋**非常有限**，主要由聖荷西市內及周邊、以及北部西海岸的眾多徒步拍攝所組成。在海岸西南方 500 公里處的[可可島](https://goo.gl/maps/RUkuKe4mafK2gbss9)也有覆蓋，南部西海岸的[卡尼奧島](https://goo.gl/maps/CabJDTQ4Cox9ycSQ6)周邊則有一艘船隻徒步拍攝。

text: At the Juan Santamaría International Airport you can find the trekker walking in the middle of a major four-lane road. There is also coverage just [outside the airport terminal](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d9V4x5cF5arGJQvK9).
text_zh: 在胡安·聖塔瑪利亞國際機場，你可以發現徒步拍攝正走在主要四線道馬路的中央。在[機場航廈外側](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d9V4x5cF5arGJQvK9)也有覆蓋。

text: In Centro Recreativo Bosque de la Hoja, just east of San José de la Montaña, you can see the trekker being followed by **three dogs** through a pine forest.
text_zh: 在位於聖荷西德拉蒙塔尼亞（San José de la Montaña）東側的波斯克德拉霍哈休閒中心（Centro Recreativo Bosque de la Hoja），你可以看到徒步拍攝穿過一片松樹林，身後跟著**三隻狗**。

text: Generation 3 coverage often has a non-standard car blur where the **side mirrors** of the car are partially visible. This is not unique to Croatia, but by far most common there.
NOTE: Sometimes, you can see a small circular [**yellow **sticker](https://goo.gl/maps/8T97sBibVM3pgwEZ9) on the car mirror. This sticker is unique to Croatia.
text_zh: 第 3 代覆蓋通常有非標準的車輛模糊處理，車子的**側邊後視鏡**會部分露出。這並非克羅埃西亞獨有，但在那裡絕對最常見。
注意：有時候，你可以在車子的後照鏡上看到一個小的圓形[**黃色**貼紙](https://goo.gl/maps/8T97sBibVM3pgwEZ9)。這個貼紙是克羅埃西亞特有的。

text: Croatia does not have Generation 2 car coverage. However, in some historic downtown areas, a **Generation 2 trekker** camera was used.
NOTE: In some of this trekker coverage, the Google employee’s red cap is visible.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞沒有第 2 代車載街景覆蓋。然而，在某些歷史市中心地區，使用了 **第 2 代徒步拍攝** 相機。
注意：在部分這種徒步拍攝街景中，可以看到 Google 員工的紅色帽子。

text: This **black car** with a **roof rack** is unique to Curaçao.
text_zh: 這輛帶有**車頂架**的**黑色汽車**是古拉索特有的。

text: A red generation 4 Google car can be found in both Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: A red car can be found in other European countries too.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都能找到紅色的相機世代 4 Google 車。
注意：其他歐洲國家也能找到紅色的車。

text: A black generation 4 Google car can also be found in both Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: A black car can be found in many other European countries too.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克也能找到黑色的相機世代 4 Google 車。
注意：許多其他歐洲國家也能找到黑色的車。

text: A white Google car is present in Czechia but not Slovakia.
NOTE: Other European countries can have a white Google Car.
text_zh: 捷克有一輛白色 Google 車，但斯洛伐克沒有。
注意：其他歐洲國家也可能出現白色 Google 車。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Ecuador. This camera is known as the official Ari (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur and often somewhat brownish colours. You will sometimes see a unique [red logo](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iWqtJ8ZuSgxFhEJ8A) at the front of the car.
NOTE: Within Latin America, Ecuador is the only country that has shitcam coverage.
text_zh: Google 在厄瓜多使用了一款奇怪、低畫質的相機。這款相機被稱為官方的 Ari（或「爛相機」）。它有一個寬闊的環形車身模糊，且顏色通常有點偏棕色。你 parfois 會看到車頭有一個獨特的[紅色標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iWqtJ8ZuSgxFhEJ8A)。
注意：在拉丁美洲內，厄瓜多是唯一擁有爛相機覆蓋的國家。

text: Most of the coverage in Ecuador is centred around the **western part** of the country. A large part of the Amazon rainforest has no coverage.
There is also some trekker coverage on the Galapagos Islands.
You can check out the extent of the official coverage [on this website](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=7&center=-1.7300837111164604%2C-77.11303710937501).
text_zh: 厄瓜多的大部分街景覆蓋都集中在該國的**西部**。亞馬遜雨林的大部分地區沒有街景覆蓋。
加拉巴哥群島也有一些徒步拍攝覆蓋。
你可以[在這個網站上](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=7&center=-1.7300837111164604%2C-77.11303710937501)查看官方覆蓋範圍。

text: The Google car antenna has two distinct variations:
- The “**high**” antenna (purple), where the wire around the antenna is entirely above the halfway line of the antenna.
- And the “**low**” antenna (blue) where the majority of the wire is below the halfway point of the line, and there can be a small bit poking up at the very top.
This is most useful when you have the high antenna, since it will always be in the northern half of the country.
text_zh: Google 車天線有兩種明顯的變體：
- 「**高**」天線（紫色），天線周圍的鐵絲完全位於天線中線上方。
- 以及「**低**」天線（藍色），絕大部分鐵絲位於中線下方，且最頂端可能有一小段凸出。
當你有高天線時這最有用，因為它一定會出現在該國的北部地區。

text: Egypt has very **sparse coverage**. The entirety of the coverage is in Generation 3, made with a trekker camera. Trekkers can be recognized by the fact that the camera is lower to the ground, having smaller blurs, and no car shadow.

Instead of learning a lot of country-specific clues, it is more practical to simply memorise what the trekkers look like. There are seven sections of coverage, each centred around historic places of interest, ranging from the Pyramids to Coptic churches and medieval citadels.
The coverage is limited to two general areas:
- Cairo: four trekkers.
- Alexandria: three trekkers, two of which are fairly far outside the city to its southwest (Monastery of Saint Mina and nearby archeological excavations).
text_zh: 埃及的**街景覆蓋非常稀疏**。所有的街景覆蓋都屬於第三代（Generation 3），是由徒步拍攝相機所拍攝。徒步拍攝的特徵是相機離地面較近、模糊範圍較小，且沒有車影。
與其去記大量特定國家的線索，不如直接記住徒步拍攝相機的外觀還比較實際。這裡共有七段街景覆蓋，每段都以歷史名勝為中心，從金字塔到科普特教堂和中世紀城堡應有盡有。
街景覆蓋僅限於兩個大致區域：
- 開羅：四個徒步拍攝點。
- 亞歷山大：三個徒步拍攝點，其中兩個位在城市西南方的郊區外圍（聖米納修道院及附近的考古發掘區）。

text: Many of the buildings you see in the trekker coverage are made of **sandstone**.
text_zh: 你在徒步拍攝街景中看到的許多建築都是由**砂岩**建成。

text: The great **pyramids of Giza** have trekker coverage.
NOTE: This is not to be confused with the pyramid in [Memphis](https://goo.gl/maps/GjibrhtPwBHG4Z749), which is made of glass instead of sand stone.
text_zh: 偉大的**吉薩金字塔群**擁有徒步拍攝街景。
注意：這不應與[孟斐斯](https://goo.gl/maps/GjibrhtPwBHG4Z749)的金字塔混淆，該金字塔是用玻璃建造而非砂岩。

text: The **Cairo Citadel** is an enormous fortification with a trekker walking through and around it. It can be recognized by its massive walls that are made of clean-cut sandstone blocks.
text_zh: **開羅城堡**是一座巨大的要塞，有徒步拍攝街景在其內部及周圍穿梭。其特徵是由俐落的砂岩方塊所砌成的巨大城牆。

text: The trekker in and around the [Hanging Church](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanging_Church) consists of two parts that look fairly different from each other.

Outside the church, the trekker is walking around a **normal urban Cairo street**. At most points, you will still see the church complex, its spires with crosses, and historic sandstone walls. But you will also see apartment buildings, shops, and normal pedestrian traffic.
_This trekker can be found just east of Giza, near the map label Fustat._
text_zh: [懸空教堂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanging_Church)內部與周邊的徒步拍攝由兩個看起來截然不同的部分組成。
在教堂外面，徒步拍攝相機正走在一條**開羅的普通市區街道**上。在多數視角下，你依然會看到教堂建築群、帶有十字架的尖頂以及歷史悠久的砂岩牆。但你也會看到公寓大樓、商店和正常的行人交通。
_這個徒步拍攝點位在吉薩正東方，靠近地圖標籤福斯塔特（Fustat）。_

text: At a certain point, the trekker moves from the street into the Hanging Church. Inside, you will see a **beautiful courtyard** with religious mosaics and two white church spires.
text_zh: 在某個時間點，徒步拍攝從街道轉入懸空教堂內部。在裡面，你會看到一個**美麗的中庭**，帶有宗教馬賽克裝飾和兩座白色的教堂尖頂。

text: All of Eswatini was covered by a **white** Google car without an antenna.
NOTE: Within Africa, this car can also be found in South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana.
text_zh: 史瓦帝尼全境都被沒有天線的**白色** Google 車所涵蓋。
注意：在非洲內部，這台車也可以在南非、賴索托和波札那找到。

text: The Carcass Island trekker can be recognized by the **open plains**, with the ocean clearly visible. The ground may also get rocky.
NOTE: Do not get this confused with the Faroe Islands trekker.
text_zh: 卡卡斯島的徒步拍攝可以透過**開闊平原**來辨認，海洋清晰可見。地面也可能會變得多石。
注意：不要將其與法羅群島的徒步拍攝搞混了。

text: Open plains with **slightly yellow grass** can be seen on West Point Island. The ocean will not be clearly visible on this trekker.
text_zh: 在西波因特島上可以看到帶有**微黃草叢**的開闊平原。在這個徒步拍攝中，海洋將不會清晰可見。

text: This **boat trekker** can be seen in the West Point Bay, with yellow hills in the distance with the MS National Geographic Explorer in the bay with the trekker.
text_zh: 這個**船隻徒步拍攝**可以在西波因特灣（West Point Bay）看到，遠處有黃色的山丘，國家地理探險家號（MS National Geographic Explorer）郵輪則停泊在灣內與徒步拍攝同行。

text: All Generation 3 car coverage on the Faroe Islands has a black Street View car with a **plain grey roof rack**.
NOTE: No other country with a similar landscape has a car similar to this.
text_zh: 法羅群島所有第三代相機車的街景覆蓋，都配有一輛車頂架為**素灰色**的黑色 Google 車。
註記：沒有其他擁有類似地景的國家有類似的車輛。

text: The trekker on Koltur island can typically be recognized by the narrow and low **peninsula** on the southeastern tip of the island.
text_zh: 科爾圖爾島（Koltur）上的徒步拍攝通常可以透過島嶼東南端狹窄且低矮的**半島**來識別。

text: The trekker on Eiðiskollur can be recognized by the extremely **low clouds** surrounding the peninsula.
text_zh: 埃伊迪斯科盧爾（Eiðiskollur）上的徒步拍攝可以透過環繞半島極為**低矮的雲層**來識別。

text: The trekker west of Skopun can be recognised by the **wide strait** to the north with the main islands of the Faroes in the background.
text_zh: 斯科普溫（Skopun）西側的徒步拍攝可以透過北側的**寬闊海峽**以及背景中的法羅群島主島來識別。

text: There are two distinct **pyramid-shaped mountains** to the south of the trekker on Klakkur, with a very thin layer of snow on top.
text_zh: 克拉克（Klakkur）徒步拍攝的南側有兩座形狀明顯的**金字塔形山脈**，山頂覆蓋著薄薄的雪。

text: The trekker by Gjógv features a view of the **village to the south** with snow covered mountains in the background.
text_zh: 焦格夫（Gjógv）旁的徒步拍攝可以看到**南側村莊**的景色，背景則是覆雪的山脈。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Finland. This camera is known as the **official Ari** (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur, and can be distinguished from Generation 2 by its lack of a sky halo and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Within Europe, Finland and Spain are the countries that have the most coverage with this camera. This camera should not be confused with unofficial coverage, which is also common in Finland.
text_zh: Google 在芬蘭使用了一種奇怪、低畫質的相機。這款相機被稱為 **官方阿里**（或「爛畫質相機」）。它有一個寬闊的環形車輛模糊處理，並且可以透過缺少天空光暈以及通常帶有些許棕色的色彩與第 2 代區分開來。好的地圖通常不會包含這種覆蓋，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。
註記：在歐洲境內，芬蘭和西班牙是擁有最多這種相機街景的國家。這款相機不應與芬蘭也很常見的非官方街景混淆。

text: **Generation 3 snow coverage **is only found in far northwestern Lapland.
NOTE: Be careful: this tip is specifically about regular Generation 3 coverage. Generation 2, 4, and trekker snow coverage can be found elsewhere.
text_zh: **第 3 代雪地覆蓋**僅見於拉普蘭的最西北端。
註記：請注意：這項提示專門針對一般的第三代街景。第二代、第四代和徒步拍攝雪景可以在其他地方找到。

text: Downtown Helsinki has a lot of Generation 4 **sidewalk trekker** coverage.
NOTE: This tip is specifically about Generation 4 trekker coverage. Generation 3 sidewalk trekkers can be found in many other Finnish cities.
text_zh: 赫爾辛基市中心有許多第 4 代**人行道徒步拍攝**覆蓋。
註記：這個提示專門關於第四代徒步拍攝街景。第三代人行道徒步拍攝街景可以在許多其他芬蘭城市找到。

text: All regular road** generation 3** coverage in Ghana was made with a unique Google car. It has a visible roof rack with a piece of **black tape** on the right end of the front bar. In addition, the hood of the car is usually visible, showing a street view car wrapping that features a **red rectangle** and some other recognizable elements. Normally, this unique car is all you need to identify Ghana.
NOTE: Several natural reserves were covered with different unique cars.
text_zh: 迦納所有常規的**第三代**道路街景覆蓋都是由一台獨特的 Google 車所拍攝。它有明顯的車頂架，且前車頂架右端貼有一段**黑色膠帶**。此外，通常可以看到車頭蓋，上面有街景車身包膜，包含一個**紅色長方形**和其他容易辨識的元素。通常，這台獨特的車就是你識別迦納所需的全部線索。
註：幾個自然保護區使用了不同的獨特車輛進行拍攝。

text: Ghana features 3 distinct types of tape on the google car:

In the southwest, you can find the ‘[unpeeled tape](https://www.google.com/maps/@5.0031389,-2.025501,3a,17.5y,227.34h,35.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s62SoTE21Q6VCvYwLPIrzhA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)’, which is essentially a mostly **intact tape**, which is not peeling off.
In the east and north, you can find the ‘[peeled tape](https://goo.gl/maps/aCFqaQwVS6q6zmqh7)’, which unlike the ‘unpeeled tape’, is slightly **peeled off**.
North of Kumasi, and west of Tamale, you can find this ‘[scotched tape](https://goo.gl/maps/zZadCxUZeGzku5QS8)’, which has two distinct **white spots** on the left side of the tape.
text_zh: 迦納的 Google 車上有 3 種不同類型的膠帶：
在西南部，你可以找到『[未撕開的膠帶](https://www.google.com/maps/@5.0031389,-2.025501,3a,17.5y,227.34h,35.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s62SoTE21Q6VCvYwLPIrzhA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)』，這基本上是一條大致**完好且未剝落**的膠帶。
在東部和北部，你可以找到『[剝落的膠帶](https://goo.gl/maps/aCFqaQwVS6q6zmqh7)』，它與『未撕開的膠帶』不同，是有點**剝落**開來的。
在庫馬西以北、塔馬利（Tamale）以西，你可以找到這條『[有膠帶痕跡的膠帶](https://goo.gl/maps/zZadCxUZeGzku5QS8)』，它的膠帶左側有兩個明顯的**白色光斑**。

text: The Ankasa Game Reserve has a unique Google car. The entire front of the Google car **can be seen,** with only the actual camera blurred. The roof of the car will have a street view vinyl and the ‘Ghana tape’ will be present.
text_zh: 安卡薩野生動物保護區（Ankasa Game Reserve）有一台獨特的 Google 車。整台 Google 車的車頭**都可以被看到，**只有實際的相機鏡頭被打了馬賽克。車頂上會有街景車身貼膜，且「迦納膠帶」也會出現。

text: The Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary has a unique Google car. The ‘Ghana tape’ and roof rack will **not **be visible however, the **black right side mirror** will be slightly visible just outside the blur.
NOTE: The red soil and surrounding vegetation should still be good clues for the country, despite the lack of the typical car meta associated with Ghana.
text_zh: 波本費馬猴子保護區（Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary）有一台獨特的 Google 車。「迦納膠帶」和車頂架將**不會**被看到，不過**黑色右側後視鏡**會在馬賽克外圍微微露出。
註：儘管缺乏與迦納相關的典型車輛特徵，但紅色的土壤和周圍的植被仍然是該國很好的線索。

text: All coverage in Greenland was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker camera**, which was often attached to a variety of vehicles.
text_zh: 格陵蘭的所有街景覆蓋都是使用 **第三代徒步拍攝相機** 拍攝的，該相機通常安裝在各種不同的載具上。

text: Most locations with coverage will have their own odd and **unique Street View vehicles**, ranging from a [red tractor](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHBFXWN9aCUpivDLA) to a snowmobile with a [large box](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uZLdPkeR8AV62wox6) at the front.
text_zh: 大多數有覆蓋的地點都有其奇特且**獨特的街景車**，從[紅色曳引機](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHBFXWN9aCUpivDLA)到前方有[大型箱子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uZLdPkeR8AV62wox6)的雪地摩托車都有。

text: The city of Sisimiut can be easily recognized by the black snowmobile with side mirrors **pointing straight up**. The coverage is generally very overcast and grey.
text_zh: 西西米尤特市可以透過側視鏡**直直朝上**的黑色雪地摩托車輕易辨識。這裡的街景通常非常陰沉灰暗。

text: Uummannaq has two distinctive features: a **sharp mountain** to the north and a green snowmobile with **large** **black side mirrors**. Neither of the two can be seen on all coverage but at least one can be seen on most.
text_zh: Uummannaq 有兩個獨特的特徵：北邊有一座**尖山**，以及一台裝有**大型** **黑色側邊後視鏡**的綠色雪上摩托車。這兩個特徵不一定會出現在所有街景覆蓋中，但通常至少能看到其中一個。

text: The entire Google car is blurred, however an **antenna** at the front right and a tiny part of the **roof rack** can be seen.
NOTE: You will not see a roof rack on the Northern Mariana Islands Google car.
text_zh: 整輛 Google 車都有模糊處理，但在右前方可以看到一根**天線**以及**車頂架**的一小部分。
注意：在北馬利安納群島的 Google 車上你看不到車頂架。

text: This **grey** Street View car with a visible roof rack and side mirrors can be seen on all car coverage in Guatemala.

NOTE: The only other tropical country with a similar car is [Laos](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uMGhM4Th1yi9GsaT9). The car used in the [Dominican Republic](https://goo.gl/maps/Hjv6G6xFYJm1F38i6) may look similar, but has thick black stripes on the bars and the mirrors are not visible.
text_zh: 這輛車頂架和車側後視鏡清晰可見的**灰色** Google 車，可在瓜地馬拉的所有汽車覆蓋中看到。
注意：唯一擁有類似 Google 車的熱帶國家是[寮國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uMGhM4Th1yi9GsaT9)。[多明尼加共和國](https://goo.gl/maps/Hjv6G6xFYJm1F38i6)使用的 Google 車看起來可能很相似，但橫桿上有粗黑條紋且後照鏡不可見。

text: A trekker featuring several **Mayan temples** can be found just west of the town of Tikal.

It is worth mentioning that while there are other Guatemalan trekkers featuring [Mayan ruins](https://goo.gl/maps/fTti23Fq4zrCGzUE6), this is by far the most prominent and contains the largest and most intact temple structures.
text_zh: 一個有著數座**馬雅神廟**的徒步拍攝可以在蒂卡爾鎮的正西方找到。
值得一提的是，雖然還有其他具備[馬雅遺跡](https://goo.gl/maps/fTti23Fq4zrCGzUE6)的瓜地馬拉徒步拍攝，但這是迄今為止最顯眼的一個，並且包含最大且保存最完整的神廟結構。

text: On the three largest islands, namely Hawaiʻi, Maui and Oʻahu, smallcam coverage was taken with a **black Google car**.
text_zh: 在三個最大的島嶼上，即夏威夷島、茂宜島和歐胡島，小相機街景是由一台**黑色 Google 車**拍攝的。

text: Kahoʻolawe is a small island that lies just to the southwest of Maui. It only has **trekker** coverage on small gravel roads and dirt trails, and is characterised by dry, shrubby vegetation, rolling hills, and **dark red soil**. On the western end of this coverage, [several buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9) can be seen.
text_zh: 卡胡奧拉韋島（Kahoʻolawe）是位於茂宜島（Maui）西南方的一座小島。它的小碎石路和泥土小徑只有**徒步拍攝**涵蓋，並以乾燥、灌木叢生的植被、起伏的山丘和**深紅色土壤**為特徵。在這個涵蓋範圍的西端，可以看到[數棟建築物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9)。

text: Between Hong Kong Island and Lantau Island, there are three unique islands: Peng Chau, Cheung Chau and Lamma Island, with **trekker **coverage. These islands can be identified by the **lack of cars**, narrow streets, and rural architecture. Lamma Island is also the hilliest of the three.
text_zh: 在香港島和大嶼山之間，有三座獨特的島嶼：坪洲、長洲和南丫島，設有**徒步拍攝**街景。這些島嶼的特徵是**沒有汽車**、狹窄的街道以及鄉村建築。南丫島也是三者中最多山的。

text: It is somewhat common to see a small, grey flag on the antenna of Generation 3 Google cars in Hungary.
NOTE: This is also seen in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania and Bulgaria.
text_zh: 在匈牙利的第三代 Google 車天線上，偶爾會看到一面灰色的小旗子。
注意：這在捷克、斯洛伐克、羅馬尼亞和保加利亞也能看到。

text: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Hungary.
NOTE: It can also be found in other European countries.
text_zh: 在匈牙利也很少機會能找到白色的第四代 Google 車。
注意：這也可以在其他歐洲國家找到。

text: The Generation 3 Google car in Iceland is a **white** **car** with a **long antenna**.
text_zh: 冰島的第 3 代 Google 車是一輛**白色**的**車**，配有**長天線**。

text: The coverage in Iraq is limited to a single trekker in the **Iraqi National Museum** in Baghdad.
text_zh: 伊拉克的街景覆蓋僅限於巴格達的**伊拉克國家博物館**（Iraqi National Museum）內的一個徒步拍攝。

text: All of the coverage in Iraq is taken by a **trekker** with a camera similar to **Gen 2 **but with distinctly worse image quality and colour. This coverage tends to be overexposed, even becoming blindingly so [at some points](https://goo.gl/maps/YyzKFREKZvguinm16).
NOTE: This camera quality is sometimes referred to as Gen 1.5.
text_zh: 伊拉克的全數覆蓋都是由**徒步拍攝**所拍攝，其相機類似**第二代**，但畫質與色彩明顯更差。這種覆蓋通常曝光過度，[在某些地方](https://goo.gl/maps/YyzKFREKZvguinm16)甚至刺眼。
注意：這種相機品質有時被稱為 Gen 1.5。

text: The trekker blur has a well-defined, **pointed** **shape**.
text_zh: 徒步拍攝的模糊效果具有明確定義的**尖銳****形狀**。

text: The appearance of the standard Japanese Google car is often **black and white**. You may find it in [black](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.545526,140.3963943,3a,75y,199.92h,63.31t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sULSsNXwYSpwiLMrI-UT9Sg!2e0!5s20120901T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) or rarely with an [antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/4eZr42n9iQuCjk9f9).
In addition, due to privacy reasons, the camera is intentionally set lower to the ground. This is known as **low-cam**. You can identify it by:
- Looking downwards. The blur will be noticeably larger.
- The road will look wider, and objects will be viewed from a lower perspective.

NOTE: The only other country that always has low-cam is [Switzerland](https://goo.gl/maps/NgSfAc8sDEh4reQy7). It can also be seen in Generation 4 coverage in [Sri Lanka](https://goo.gl/maps/DisPbnfvKkJdXc3TA). Also, the car will be blurred in Switzerland.
text_zh: 日本的標準 Google 拍攝車多半是**黑白配色**，也找得到[全黑](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.545526,140.3963943,3a,75y,199.92h,63.31t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sULSsNXwYSpwiLMrI-UT9Sg!2e0!5s20120901T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的版本，偶爾會有[裝天線](https://goo.gl/maps/4eZr42n9iQuCjk9f9)的。
此外基於隱私考量，日本的相機刻意架得比較低，也就是所謂的**低機位**。判斷方式：
- 往下看，車體的模糊區塊明顯較大。
- 路面看起來較寬，周遭物體都是從偏低的視角看出去。
註：另一個全境都是低機位的國家只有[瑞士](https://goo.gl/maps/NgSfAc8sDEh4reQy7)，[斯里蘭卡](https://goo.gl/maps/DisPbnfvKkJdXc3TA)的第四代街景也看得到。另外瑞士的拍攝車車體會被模糊處理。

text: [Giant butterbur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petasites_japonicus) (commonly referred to as cabbage) is abundant in **Hokkaido** and some northern prefectures. Plants found south of Hokkaido often have [smaller leaves](https://goo.gl/maps/H79sWvJQ7NUy5EWe9). It is often found growing along the roadside.
NOTE: Cabbage is also found on the island of [Sakhalin](https://goo.gl/maps/cDP6L1rjVAQxszS46), Russia. However, the Google car will not have low-cam there.
text_zh: [蜂斗菜](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petasites_japonicus)（社群俗稱 cabbage）在**北海道**與部分北部縣份大量生長。北海道以南的植株[葉片通常較小](https://goo.gl/maps/H79sWvJQ7NUy5EWe9)。常沿著路邊生長。
註：俄羅斯的[庫頁島](https://goo.gl/maps/cDP6L1rjVAQxszS46)也有蜂斗菜，但那裡的 Google 拍攝車不是低機位。

text: Coverage in Jordan was taken by a **black** Google car, without a red brake light.
NOTE: Jordan is the only Middle Eastern country where a black Google car without an antenna or a red brake light can be found.
text_zh: 約旦的街景是由一台沒有紅色煞車燈的**黑色** Google 車拍攝的。
註：約旦是中東唯一能找到沒有天線或紅色煞車燈的黑色 Google 車的國家。

text: West of the town of **Wadi Musa**, a collection of trekkers can be found in and around **Petra**, a rock-cut city from antiquity. This trekker coverage features highly eroded reddish rocks, narrow gorges, and occasionally groups of tourists crowding around the archaeological sites.
NOTE: While not likely to appear in competitive or pinpointable maps, these trekkers are a mainstay in many maps, including the default World map.
text_zh: 在**瓦迪穆薩**鎮以西，可以在古代石刻城市**佩特拉**（Petra）內及周邊找到一系列徒步拍攝影像（trekker）。這項徒步拍攝街景的特徵是高度侵蝕的微紅色岩石、狹窄的峽谷，以及偶爾聚集在考古遺址周圍的遊客群。
注意：雖然這些 trekker 不太可能出現在競技或可精準定位的地圖中，但它們是許多地圖（包含預設的 World 地圖）中的主要元素。

text: Kenya has many **unique **Google cars in and around its National Parks and Reserves. These are still identifiable by the snorkel which is present in almost all of them.
Many of the National Park and Reserve cars must be used in conjunction with landscape, as they can be found in multiple areas.
_You can learn more about these National Parks and Reserves in the spotlight section._
text_zh: 肯亞的國家公園及保護區內外有許多**獨特的** Google 車。這些車輛依然可以透過幾乎每輛車上都有的進氣 snorkel 來辨識。
許多國家公園和保護區的車輛必須結合地景來判斷，因為它們可能出現在多個地區。
_你可以在特輯單元中了解更多關於這些國家公園與保護區的資訊。_

text: Aberdare National Park** **has a **grey and brown** car that features a large snorkel. Almost all of the coverage is outside of the National Park, with only two roads within the park covered. The main road through the park has [these](https://goo.gl/maps/g4D2K3mtsHqrAwKr7) rubber bands on the roof rack, which can only be found in one other National Park in Kenya.
text_zh: 亞伯德爾國家公園有一輛**灰色和棕色**且配備大型進氣 snorkel 的車。幾乎所有的街景覆蓋都在國家公園外，公園內只有兩條道路有覆蓋。穿過公園的主幹道上車頂行李架有[這些](https://goo.gl/maps/g4D2K3mtsHqrAwKr7)橡皮筋，這點只能在肯亞的另一個國家公園找到。

text: Learning which direction the Google Car is driving on most major roads will help you narrow down your options when guessing.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 了解 Google 車在多數主要道路上行駛的方向，有助於你在猜測時縮小範圍。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: You can use the Google car’s mirror to region-guess Kyrgyzstan. In the southern region, **less of the road is visible** on the mirror. The car’s reflection is more diagonal. For comparison, this is what it usually [looks like](https://goo.gl/maps/hcZKoj5RDCHUQvpR8).
text_zh: 你可以利用 Google 車的後視鏡來判斷吉爾吉斯的大致區域。在南部地區，後視鏡中**可以看到較少的道路**。車子的反光呈較為對角線的角度。作為對比，這通常是它[看起來的樣子](https://goo.gl/maps/hcZKoj5RDCHUQvpR8)。

text: Street View coverage in Laos is very **limited**. Only five cities are covered: Vientiane, Vang Vieng, Luang Prabang, Savannakhet, and Pakse.
In addition, all coverage in Laos was taken by a Generation 3 camera.

All five cities have a distinct look and with some practise they are easily distinguishable from each other. The differences are discussed in more detail in the region-guessing section, but the summarized version is as follows:
- **Luang Prabang**: historical architecture, hills, palms
- **Vang Vieng**: distinct mountains
- **Vientiane**: no roof rack, large city
- **Savannakhet**: very flat
- **Pakse**: red soil, arid, hills
text_zh: 寮國的街景覆蓋非常**有限**。只有五個城市有覆蓋：永珍（Vientiane）、旺陽（Vang Vieng）、龍坡邦（Luang Prabang）、沙灣拿吉（Savannakhet）和巴色（Pakse）。
此外，寮國的所有覆蓋都是由第 3 相機世代拍攝的。
這五個城市都有獨特的外觀，經過一些練習後，它們很容易彼此區分。這些差異將在區域猜題部分進行更詳細的討論，但總結版本如下：
- **龍坡邦**：歷史建築、山丘、棕櫚樹
- **旺陽**：特異的山峰
- **永珍**：沒有車頂架、大城市
- **沙灣拿吉**：非常平坦
- **巴色**：紅土、乾旱、山丘

text: In all cities except for the capital, Vientiane, this Google car will be visible. It is silver-coloured, with a **roof rack** with two metal bars and black side mirrors.
NOTE: A similar car can be found in Guatemala, so be sure to look at the other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 除了首都永珍之外的所有城市，都可以看到這輛 Google 車。它是銀色的，配有一個帶有兩根金屬桿和黑色側視鏡的**車頂架**。
註記：瓜地馬拉也能找到類似的車輛，所以在猜測之前務必查看其他線索。

text: As previously mentioned, the Vientiane area is the only part of Laos where the Google car is **not **visible. It also has a considerable amount of rural coverage, especially to its southeast.
NOTE: This may lead to toss-ups with Thailand and Cambodia. Use the driving side (Thailand being left, and Laos and Cambodia right), along with other clues to tell them apart.
text_zh: 如前所述，永珍地區是寮國唯一**看不到** Google 車的地區。它也有相當多的鄉村街景覆蓋，特別是在其東南部。
註記：這可能會導致與泰國和柬埔寨難分難解。請使用行駛方向（泰國為左側，寮國和柬埔寨為右側）以及其他線索來區分牠們。

text: The only trekker in Laos is a view of the monumental **Patuxai** arch, a massive war memorial in the middle of Vientiane. Some of the coverage is made with a normal trekker, and some with a [tripod](https://goo.gl/maps/Jhfo521otTgghE1W9).
text_zh: 寮國唯一的徒步拍攝街景是宏偉的**凱旋門**（Patuxai），這是一座位於永珍市中心的大型戰爭紀念碑。部分覆蓋是用普通徒步拍攝製作的，部分則是用[三腳架](https://goo.gl/maps/Jhfo521otTgghE1W9)拍攝的。

text: A red generation 4 Google car can be found in Latvia.
NOTE: It can also be found in a few other European countries, including Lithuania, but not Estonia.
text_zh: 在拉脫維亞可以找到紅色的第 4 代 Google car。
注意：它也可以在其他少數歐洲國家找到，包含立陶宛，但不包括愛沙尼亞。

text: A black generation 4 Google car can also be found in Latvia.
NOTE: It can also be found in many other European countries, including Lithuania, but not Estonia.
text_zh: 在拉脫維亞也可以找到黑色的第 4 代 Google car。
注意：它也可以在許多其他歐洲國家找到，包含立陶宛，但不包括愛沙尼亞。

text: Apart from the shitcam, all of the Lebanese coverage was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker**.
text_zh: 除了爛畫質相機外，所有黎巴嫩的街景覆蓋都是用**第 3 代徒步拍攝**拍攝的。

text: The Generation 3 trekker coverage in Lebanon is **extremely limited**, mostly being found around tourist attractions, university campuses and trails. Note that due to the large number of distinct trekkers, this guide will only cover those that are considered pinpointable.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩的第 3 代徒步拍攝街景**極為有限**，主要分佈在觀光景點、大學校園和步道周邊。請注意，由於有大量不同的徒步拍攝設備，本指南僅涵蓋那些被認為可以精準定位的內容。

text: The trekker near Bsharri can be recognised by the **large canyon** to the south.
text_zh: 布夏里附近的徒步拍攝可以透過南方的**大型峽谷**來辨識。

text: The only **rural coastal road** with trekker coverage in Lebanon can be found southwest of Tripoli.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩唯一有徒步拍攝覆蓋的**鄉村沿海公路**位於黎波里西南方。

text: All coverage in Lesotho is **Generation 3**. In almost all locations, the back of a **white** Google car without an antenna is visible.
NOTE: Among southern African countries, Eswatini, Botswana and South Africa also have the same white car in Generation 3 coverage.
While Botswana and Eswatini only have Generation 3 coverage, South Africa also has Generation 2 and Generation 4 coverage. In addition, Generation 3 coverage is somewhat rare in South Africa.
text_zh: 賴索托的所有街景覆蓋都是**第 3 代**。在幾乎所有地點，都可以看到沒有天線的**白色** Google car 車尾。
注意：在南部非洲國家中，史瓦帝尼、波札那和南非在第 3 代街景中也有相同的白車。
雖然波札那和史瓦帝尼只有第 3 代街景，但南非同時擁有第 2 代和第 4 代街景。此外，第 3 代街景在南非相對罕見。

text: Qacha's Nek is a very recognizable town that is located far away from most other towns, on the southeastern border with South Africa.
It is situated right in the middle of **green mountains**, and it had noticeably **bad weather** when the Google car drove there.
text_zh: 卡查斯內克（Qacha's Nek）是一個非常容易辨識的城鎮，位於距離大多數其他城鎮很遠的東南部與南非邊境上。
它坐落於**綠色山脈**的正中間，當 Google car 開過去時，那裡的**天氣明顯很糟**。

text: All coverage in Liechtenstein is **low-cam**. This means that the camera on the Google car is intentionally set up lower than in most other countries. This can be recognized in two ways:
- The car blur is significantly bigger.
- Roads look wider and objects around you are seen from a lower angle.
Generally, the bigger car blur is the most consistent way to recognize low-cam.

NOTE: The only other countries that always have low-cam are [Switzerland](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mq5nCexiy7KfsV8E8) and [Japan](https://www.google.com/maps/@35.8415638,139.9145236,3a,75y,305.11h,83.84t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D33.088177%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 列支敦斯登的所有街景覆蓋都是**低相機視角（low-cam）**。這意味著 Google car 上的相機刻意設定得比大多數其他國家還要低。這可以透過兩種方式辨識：
- 車影模糊範圍明顯更大。
- 道路看起來更寬，你周圍的物體是以更低的視角被看見。
通常來說，較大的車影模糊是辨識低相機視角最一致的方法。

注意：唯一其他總是採用低相機視角的國家是[瑞士](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mq5nCexiy7KfsV8E8)和[日本](https://www.google.com/maps/@35.8415638,139.9145236,3a,75y,305.11h,83.84t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D33.088177%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: A black generation 4 Google car can be found in Lithuania.
NOTE: It can also be found in a few other European countries, including Latvia, but not Estonia.
text_zh: 在立陶宛可以找到黑色的第四代（Generation 4）Google 車。
注意：它也可以在其他少數歐洲國家找到，包括拉脫維亞，但愛沙尼亞沒有。

text: A red generation 4 Google car can also be found in Lithuania.
NOTE: It can also be found in a few other European countries, including Latvia, but not Estonia.
text_zh: 在立陶宛也能找到紅色的第四代（Generation 4）Google 車。
注意：它也可以在其他少數歐洲國家找到，包括拉脫維亞，但愛沙尼亞沒有。

text: Some of Luxembourg City’s downtown area was covered by a **Generation 3 urban trekker**. Occasionally, the trekker’s sunglasses and greying hair can be seen.
text_zh: 盧森堡市的部分市中心地區被**第 3 代都市徒步拍攝**覆蓋。偶爾可以看到拍攝員戴著太陽眼鏡和灰白的頭髮。

text: All coverage in Madagascar was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker** camera.
NOTE: While there are some [unusual vehicles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h5Xb4zMRj5EXpNXw8) seen on some of the coverage, the camera and blur is still the same.
text_zh: 馬達加斯加的所有街景覆蓋都是用**第 3 代徒步拍攝**相機拍攝的。
注意：雖然某些覆蓋上可以看到一些[不尋常的載具](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h5Xb4zMRj5EXpNXw8)，但相機和模糊效果仍然是一樣的。

text: Most coverage features one or several people walking alongside the trekker. These people can be used both to recognise the country and to regionguess it.
text_zh: 大多數覆蓋的特色是有一人或多人走在徒步拍攝旁邊。這些人可以用來辨識國家以及進行區域猜測。

text: Ambiky can be recognized by the large number of **palms** combined with the **brown**, sandy dirt road. In most of the coverage, there is a person walking in front of the trekker with a grey T-shirt and a brown backpack.
text_zh: 安比基（Ambiky）可以透過大量的**棕櫚樹**結合**棕色**的沙質泥土路來辨識。在大多數覆蓋中，前方有一人走在徒步拍攝前面，背著灰色 T 恤和棕色背包。

text: The coverage on the RN8 between Andriamena and Marofandilia can easily be recognized by the large **silver roof rack** on the Street View car. The coverage is very dry and sandy.
text_zh: Andriamena 和 Marofandilia 之間的 RN8 公路上的覆蓋可以輕易透過街景車上大型的**銀色車頂行李架**來辨識。該覆蓋非常乾燥且多沙。

text: The trekker next to the RN8 can be recognized by its extreme dryness, combined with the **four people** wearing red, blue, grey and light blue respectively.
text_zh: RN8 旁的徒步拍攝可以透過其極度的乾燥，以及**四個人**（分別穿著紅、藍、灰和淺藍色）來辨識。

text: Morondava is most easily recognized by the bald person wearing either a light green or a [light red](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.2922811,44.2728557,2a,90y,38.6h,75.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdLo7gIsqBtj0LwG4gDh_PQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) striped shirt. It is also one of few towns where the trekker walks on a paved road.
text_zh: 穆龍達瓦（Morondava）最容易透過穿著淺綠色或[淺紅色](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.2922811,44.2728557,2a,90y,38.6h,75.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdLo7gIsqBtj0LwG4gDh_PQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)條紋襯衫的光頭人士來辨識。這也是徒步拍攝行走在柏油路上的少數城鎮之一。

text: A car with a barely visible **grey metal roof rack** can be seen by Manahy. There are some locations where the car is completely [blurred out](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.8635885,43.9144054,2a,75y,201.67h,54.09t,3.83r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D280%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656), where the shape of the blur is the best indication of the area.
text_zh: 在馬納希（Manahy）附近可以看到一輛車頂行李架幾乎看不見的**灰色金屬車頂行李架**的汽車。有些地方車子被完全[模糊處理](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.8635885,43.9144054,2a,75y,201.67h,54.09t,3.83r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D280%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656)，此時模糊的形狀是該地區的最佳指示。

text: The main part of the trekker coverage surrounding Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the person wearing a greyish hat and light blue shirt or a person wearing a** **[yellow T-shirt](https://goo.gl/maps/tk4eKhBmyttFugDG9).
text_zh: 環繞安達瓦多卡的徒步拍攝主要部分可以透過戴著灰灰色帽子和淺藍色襯衫的人，或是穿著[**黃色** T 恤](https://goo.gl/maps/tk4eKhBmyttFugDG9)的人來辨識。

text: A second Trekker, going to the northeast of Andavadoaka can be recognized by a person with a **light blue T-shirt**.
text_zh: 另一輛徒步拍攝前往安達瓦多阿卡（Andavadoaka）東北方時，可以透過一位穿著**淺藍色 T 恤**的人來辨識。

text: Coverage on a somewhat **rocky** ground with **no people** following the trekker can be found southwest of the bay.
text_zh: 在帶有**岩石**地面的街景覆蓋中，且**沒有人**跟著徒步拍攝，位於海灣的西南方。

text: Coverage with multiple different people walking near and around the trekker, and with a [small village](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.2385629,43.2972032,2a,90y,125.63h,91.6t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3dMI1dhBOWDorIiI3h7DrQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) to the west, can be found in the southeastern part of the bay. Part of the coverage goes through a very [shallow body of water](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rZReKRbq4E5qccdeA).
text_zh: 帶有多位不同的人在徒步拍攝附近及周圍走動的街景覆蓋，且西方有一個[小村莊](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.2385629,43.2972032,2a,90y,125.63h,91.6t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3dMI1dhBOWDorIiI3h7DrQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)，可以在海灣的東南部找到。部分街景覆蓋會穿過一處非常[淺的水域](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rZReKRbq4E5qccdeA)。

text: The Tsaranoro Massif is a large [**monolithic mountain**](https://goo.gl/maps/coxbSnD6beVYspY19) with trekker coverage. The steep mountainsides, combined with the mountainous area surrounding the coverage makes it very recognizable. The [four people](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.0973126,46.7594034,2a,90y,182.36h,90.99t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0NR1H26JY_5a9JRRVRluDw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) following the trekker can also occasionally be a useful clue.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅山塊（Tsaranoro Massif）是一座大型[**巨石山**](https://goo.gl/maps/coxbSnD6beVYspY19)，具備徒步拍攝街景覆蓋。陡峭的山壁，加上環繞街景覆蓋的山區使其非常好認。跟著徒步拍攝的[四個人](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.0973126,46.7594034,2a,90y,182.36h,90.99t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0NR1H26JY_5a9JRRVRluDw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)有時也是一個有用的線索。

text: A small part of the coverage in Tsaranoro was taken inside a forest, which occasionally hides the surrounding mountains. The best way to recognize this area is the relatively **dark coverage**, combined with the four people following the trekker.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅的一小部分街景覆蓋是在森林內部拍攝的，這偶爾會遮蔽周圍的山脈。辨識這個區域的最佳方式是相對**昏暗的街景覆蓋**，結合跟著徒步拍攝的四個人。

text: Toliara can be recognized as being a generally quite busy-looking town and the only large town on Madagascar with **no person** following the trekker.
text_zh: 圖利亞拉（Toliara）可以透過整體看起來相當繁忙的城鎮來辨識，且它是馬達加斯加唯一一個**沒有人**跟著徒步拍攝的大城鎮。

text: Two pieces of coverage can be recognized by two people following the trekker; one with a **yellow tank top** and one with a **blue T-shirt**. The first of these two parts is located in the town of St Augustin.
text_zh: 有兩段街景覆蓋可以透過跟著徒步拍攝的兩個人來辨識；一人穿著**黃色背心**，另一人穿著**藍色 T 恤**。這兩部分的第一段位於聖奧古斯丁（St Augustin）鎮。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera on Madeira, commonly known as the official Ari (or "shitcam"). It has a wide circular car blur and makes the image appear rather gloomy. On Madeira, you will often see the unblurred back of a **white** car.
A good map will usually not include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order not to be caught off-guard.
text_zh: Google 在馬德拉使用了一種奇怪、畫質低劣的相機，通常被稱為官方 Ari（或「爛相機」）。它有一個寬闊的圓形車體模糊，讓畫面顯得相當陰暗。在馬德拉，你經常會看到未模糊的**白色**車尾。
好的地圖通常不會包含這種街景覆蓋，但知道它的存在是件好事，以免被打個措手不及。

text: All this trekker coverage is made with a regular consumer-grade camera on a **tripod**. This gives all the coverage a very peculiar and recognizable look, which is different from the normal backpack trekkers. It can have a slightly ‘ethereal’ look to it, but it is recommended to simply click on a few of the locations to get a feeling for what it looks like. Objects in the image will usually have motion blur, and slightly saturated colours.
From here on, the Mali tripod trekkers will be simply referred to as “tripods”.
NOTE: Tripods can also be found in several other countries.
text_zh: 所有這些徒步拍攝都是用**三腳架**架著一般消費級相機拍攝的。這讓所有的街景呈現出一種非常奇特且好辨認的外觀，與一般的背包徒步拍攝不同。它可能帶有一點「空靈」的感覺，但建議直接點進幾個地點來感受一下它的長相。畫面中的物件通常會有動態模糊，且顏色稍微飽和。
從這裡開始，馬利的三腳架徒步拍攝將簡稱為「三腳架」。
注意：其他幾個國家也能找到三腳架。

text: This trekker on a ship that is painted **white and blue** can be seen between the main island and Gozo Island.
text_zh: 這個位於漆成**白藍相間**船隻上的徒步拍攝可以在主島和戈佐島之間看到。

text: Habitation Clément is a **rum distillery** covered by a trekker. Due to it being pinpointable, some locations are on maps such as [ACW](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914). There are several landscapes in and around the distillery, including:
- A [warehouse](https://goo.gl/maps/zSrUUsk3JPYyyP8YA) with a truck and a forklift.
- A [view of the outside](https://goo.gl/maps/FW2mfgwes23dj1yd6) with hills in the background and machinery on display.
- A [rural dirt track](https://goo.gl/maps/3Wx7QjXUcCUVRuRU9) outside with red soil and palm trees.
- The [inside of the distillery](https://goo.gl/maps/mnoysxVXLY5VZBpN7) with the structure made of H-beam steel.
text_zh: 克萊芒莊園（Habitation Clément）是一個有徒步拍攝覆蓋的**蘭姆酒蒸餾廠**。由於它是可精準定位的，因此有些位置會出現在諸如 [ACW](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914) 等地圖上。蒸餾廠內外有幾種景觀，包括：
- 一個有卡車和堆高機的[倉庫](https://goo.gl/maps/zSrUUsk3JPYyyP8YA)。
- 一個[戶外景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/FW2mfgwes23dj1yd6)，背景有山丘並展示著機械。
- 外部的[農村泥土小徑](https://goo.gl/maps/3Wx7QjXUcCUVRuRU9)，有著紅土和棕櫚樹。
- 蒸餾廠[內部](https://goo.gl/maps/mnoysxVXLY5VZBpN7)，其結構由 H 型鋼梁製成。

text: The **coastal southern trekker** can be recognized by a few unique things:
- [In the north](https://goo.gl/maps/pApNFF5yFbPfWrry5), the trekker starts off walking on a slightly hilly path, with other people.
- [Several houses](https://goo.gl/maps/XxD6aTzoBNrF5qPF9) with orange roofs can be seen.
- [A flatter and more open path](https://goo.gl/maps/DGkgXWthbCLEnskA7) can be seen, with the ocean slightly visible through the trees.
- [The coverage ends in the south](https://goo.gl/maps/9DxD1KWqV83XHPzh7) with a car park and some stalls.
text_zh: **南部沿海徒步拍攝**可以透過幾件獨特的事情來辨識：
- [在北部](https://goo.gl/maps/pApNFF5yFbPfWrry5)，徒步拍攝一開始是走在稍微起伏的小徑上，旁邊有其他人。
- 可以看到[幾棟](https://goo.gl/maps/XxD6aTzoBNrF5qPF9)有橘色屋頂的房子。
- 可以看到[一條更平坦、更開闊的小徑](https://goo.gl/maps/DGkgXWthbCLEnskA7)，透過樹木隱約能看到海洋。
- [覆蓋在南部結束](https://goo.gl/maps/9DxD1KWqV83XHPzh7)，有一個停車場和一些攤位。

text: The Jardin de Balata trekker is the most **tropical** and **humid** feeling on Martinique. The trekker can be recognized by dark and damp feeling, the trees with [buttress roots](https://goo.gl/maps/kmvFzPJvGuvtoBtj6), [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/qBrahrtWA29634dU6) and [bamboo](https://goo.gl/maps/NDEVBU9sPAfnhvF6A). [This man](https://goo.gl/maps/Z3eXTHiJwapSoPU17) wearing a black shirt and grey cap can sometimes be seen with the trekker.
text_zh: 巴拉達花園（Jardin de Balata）徒步拍攝是馬丁尼克感覺最**熱帶**且最**潮濕**的。這個徒步拍攝可以透過黑暗潮濕的感覺、帶有[板根](https://goo.gl/maps/kmvFzPJvGuvtoBtj6)的樹木、[蕨類](https://goo.gl/maps/qBrahrtWA29634dU6)和[竹子](https://goo.gl/maps/NDEVBU9sPAfnhvF6A)來辨識。[這個人](https://goo.gl/maps/Z3eXTHiJwapSoPU17)穿著黑色襯衫戴著灰色帽子，有時會和徒步拍攝一起出現。

text: In the harbour, there is an extensive **Generation 3 trekker on a boat**. The Google employee’s brown hair and sunglasses are visible. You can see Monaco’s skyline and the hills beyond it. There are a lot of expensive [yachts](https://goo.gl/maps/4Z8rnvc99PPCqQEL7) around.
This trekker shows up a lot in the official competitive game modes, so it is worth remembering.
text_zh: 在港口裡，有一台 uitgebreide 的**船上第三代徒步拍攝**。Google 員工的棕色頭髮和太陽眼鏡清晰可見。你可以看到摩納哥的天際線以及它後方的山丘。周圍有許多昂貴的[遊艇](https://goo.gl/maps/4Z8rnvc99PPCqQEL7)。
這個徒步拍攝在官方競賽遊戲模式中經常出現，所以很值得記住。

text: The roof racks of the Street View car are very useful as they can effectively split Mongolia in half. The presence of **rubber inlays** in the roof racks are generally found in the **west**, while **empty roof racks** are generally found in the **east**.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
text_zh: Google 車的車頂架非常有用，因為它們可以有效地將蒙古一分為二。車頂架上有**橡膠嵌件**的通常在**西方**，而**空車頂架**通常在**東方**。
_你可以點擊地圖來放大它。_

text: The eastern region can be further divided into several smaller areas based on the layout of the **orange** **roof rack straps**. These straps can be seen by looking straight down.
NOTE: Orange straps can be found in the west as well, this tip is only useful for the eastern car with a blue tent from the previous tip.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
text_zh: 根據**橘色**車頂架固定帶的配置，東部地區還可以進一步劃分為幾個較小的區域。直視下方就能看到這些固定帶。
注意：西方也會出現橘色固定帶，這個小技巧僅適用於前一個小技巧中配有藍色帳篷的東部車輛。
_你可以點擊地圖來放大它。_

text: Erdenet is the second largest city in Mongolia. As such, it has many multistory buildings that can be seen from across town, a large stadium, and a **ferris wheel** in the south of the city. It is surrounded by large barren hills to the south and to the north, and was covered on a **cloudy day **in the** winter**, meaning all vegetation is dead.

NOTE: Erdenet can look very similar to Darkhan and Ulaanbaatar, but the lack of snow distinguishes it from [Darkhan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6), while the cloudy skies and lack of rubber inlays on the roof racks can be used to distinguish it from [Ulaanbaatar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59).
text_zh: 額爾登特是蒙古第二大城。因此，它有許多從城鎮各處都能看見的多層樓建築、大型體育場，以及位於該市南方的**摩天輪**。城鎮南北兩側都被大型的貧瘠丘陵環繞，拍攝時正逢**冬季的陰天**，意味著所有植被都已枯死。
注意：額爾登特看起來可能非常像達爾漢和烏蘭巴托，但沒有積雪這點可以將它與[達爾漢](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6)區分開來，而陰暗的天空以及車頂架上沒有橡膠嵌件，則可以用來將它與[烏蘭巴托](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59)區分開來。

text: In the westmost part of Mongolia, there is some very remote coverage showcasing the tallest mountains in Mongolia where you can see glaciers and **snow-capped peaks**. This area also has a unique Street View car with a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.
text_zh: 在蒙古的最西部，有一些非常偏遠的街景覆蓋，展示了蒙古最高的山峰，你可以看到冰川和**雪山山頂**。這個地區還有一輛獨特的 Google 車，右側車頂行李架上方有一個綠色或黑色的袋子。

text: Knowing where the Google car is blurred, will help narrow down your options significantly. Below are some useful use cases:
- In the north, the blurred car is only northwest of [Ondangwa](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3ket3j3jLiuT1ySR7).
- The blurred car on an unpaved road likely places you on one of many [sideroads](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YjAFjGq1fFnfehcR7) of the B1 or other major roads, or in a town.
- The paved [road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XAwT2QndeUVDCXQZ7) between Nordoewer and Aussenkehr has the car unblurred.

- Other notable paved roads not north of Windhoek include the [C20](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YbHyk9drxFNRG9Z66), [C22 ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nwf92i6mjCV5vtJr8)(south of Gobabis), [C23](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kz9nib6UPgXAL5oz7).
NOTE: The blurred car strongly correlates with a 2024 copyright. Use with caution.
text_zh: 了解 Google 車在哪裡被模糊處理，將有助於大幅縮小你的選項範圍。以下是一些實用的應用情境：
- 在北部，被模糊處理的車輛僅位於 [翁當瓦](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3ket3j3jLiuT1ySR7)西北方。
- 在未鋪裝道路上被模糊處理的車輛，很可能是將你定位在 B1 或其他主要道路的眾多 [側路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YjAFjGq1fFnfehcR7)之一，或是某個城鎮中。
- 諾德奧弗（Nordoewer）與奧森凱爾（Aussenkehr）之間鋪有路面的 [道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XAwT2QndeUVDCXQZ7)上，Google 車並未被模糊處理。
- 溫特胡克（Windhoek）以北以外其他值得注意的鋪面道路包括 [C20](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YbHyk9drxFNRG9Z66)、[C22](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nwf92i6mjCV5vtJr8)（戈巴比斯[Gobabis]以南）、[C23](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kz9nib6UPgXAL5oz7)。
注意：模糊的車輛通常對應到 2024 年的版權。請謹慎使用。

text: An orange google car can be found around:
- Nepalgunj in the west
- Madi, south of Bharatpur in the central south
- Biratnagar in the east
- Birtamod in the far east.
text_zh: 橘色 Google car 可以出現在以下地點：
- 西部的尼泊爾根傑
- 中南部巴拉特普爾以南的馬迪（Madi）
- 東部的比拉特納格爾
- 極東的比爾塔莫德（Birtamod）。

text: Trekker coverage in Nepal is limited to the **northeast** of the country, in the general area southwest of Mount Everest.
text_zh: 尼泊爾的徒步拍攝範圍僅限於該國的**東北部**，大約在聖母峰西南方的區域。

text: **Green forests** and trees are found in the southern parts of the Nepalese trekker coverage.
text_zh: **綠色森林**與樹木出現在尼泊爾徒步拍攝範圍的南部。

text: Namche Bazar is by far the **largest** and **most densely populated** settlement with trekker coverage. There is also some coverage [looking down on the town](https://www.google.com/maps/@27.8056067,86.71193,2a,90y,112.78h,82.14t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9HNBGJ7FGOq9a4fOPyvWcg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 南崎巴扎是目前擁有徒步拍攝範圍中**最大**且**人口最稠密**的聚落。這裡也有一些[俯瞰該城鎮](https://www.google.com/maps/@27.8056067,86.71193,2a,90y,112.78h,82.14t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9HNBGJ7FGOq9a4fOPyvWcg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的街景。

text: The southernmost trekker coverage is situated in the town of Lukla, which can be recognised by the narrow street with relatively large buildings, combined with the **extremely dark coverage**.
text_zh: 最南端的徒步拍攝範圍位於路卡拉（Lukla）鎮，這裡的特徵是狹窄的街道搭配相對大型的建築，再加上**極度昏暗的街景**。

text: Around the southern tip of the Nepalese trekker coverage, you will get this **dark**, overcast coverage inside a forested valley.
text_zh: 在尼泊爾徒步拍攝範圍的最南端附近，你會在森林山谷中看到這種**昏暗**、陰天的街景。

text: Some Generation 4 coverage has a car blur glitch where the **black back of the Google car** is visible.
text_zh: 某些第 4 代街景覆蓋有車輛模糊瑕疵，可以看到 **Google 車的黑色車尾**。

text: In the southern part of the Veluwe, in** National Park De Hoge Veluwe**, you can find a trekker that is recognizable because the Google employee’s brown hair is visible.
text_zh: 在費呂韋（Veluwe）南部，也就是**De Hoge Veluwe 國家公園**內，你可以找到一個很好認的徒步拍攝，因為 Google 員工的棕色頭髮露出來了。

text: A **visible Street View car **is present in most of the coverage, being a pickup truck with the cab and bed visible. The colour of the cab and other features of it varies. In Generation 3, a **roof rack** is present. You may also find a large blur covering the entire pickup truck.
text_zh: 多數的街景覆蓋中都可以看到一台**Google 車**，為一台看得到車頭與車斗的小貨車。車頭的顏色與其他特徵會有所不同。在相機世代 3 中，配有**車頂架**。你可能也會發現一個大模糊遮蔽了整台小貨車。

text: The entire Google car is blurred, however an antenna at the front right can be seen. The antenna is also **noticeably closer** to the camera than in the Guam Google car.
text_zh: 整台 Google 車都有模糊處理，不過可以看見右前方有一支天線。這支天線也比關島 Google 車**明顯更靠近**相機。

text: The Omani Google car drivers covered a lot of small tracks in the middle of the Omani desert.
text_zh: 阿曼的 Google 車駕駛拍攝了阿曼沙漠中許多的小路。

text: Coverage in Pakistan was mainly taken with a Generation 3** trekker** camera.
text_zh: 巴基斯坦的街景覆蓋主要使用第 3 代**徒步拍攝**相機拍攝。

text: Just south of Lahore Fort you can find a trekker walking around some narrow urban streets that are typically very busy.
NOTE: This is also hidden coverage.
text_zh: 就在拉合爾堡的正南方，你可以找到一個徒步拍攝，漫步於一些通常非常擁擠的狹窄市區街道。
注意：這也是隱藏街景。

text: West of Sahiwal, just northwest of Harappa, you can find a trekker starting in the south at Harappa Museum. This trekker can be recognised by most of the coverage being taken on a very** narrow path **made of **concrete**.
text_zh: 在薩希瓦爾以西、哈拉帕西北方，你可以找到一個從南邊哈拉帕博物館開始的徒步拍攝。這個徒步拍攝的特徵是大部分街景都是在一條由**混凝土**製成的非常**狹窄的小徑**上拍攝的。

text: In Gen 3 coverage, Peru uses a solid **black** or **white** Google car.
NOTE: In South America, these two cars are limited to the following countries:
- The black Google car is only found in Peru, Argentina and Uruguay.
- The white Google car is only found in Peru, Bolivia and Chile.
text_zh: 在第 3 代街景覆蓋中，祕魯使用純**黑色**或**白色**的 Google 車。
注意：在南美洲中，這兩輛車僅限於以下國家：
- 黑色的 Google 車僅見於祕魯、阿根廷和烏拉圭。
- 白色的 Google 車僅見於祕魯、玻利維亞和智利。

text: A **train track** covered by a trekker is located between Aguas Calientes and Cusco.
text_zh: 一條由徒步拍攝涵蓋的**鐵軌**位於阿瓜斯卡连特斯和庫斯科之間。

text: You may find this **black** Street View car with a visible **roof rack** in and around the city of General Santos.
text_zh: 你可能會在桑托斯將軍城內及周邊地區找到這輛帶有明顯**車頂架**的**黑色**街景車。

text: All coverage was taken with a Generation 3 trekker.
text_zh: 所有街景覆蓋都是使用 Generation 3 徒步拍攝所拍攝。

text: A black generation 4 Google car can rarely be found in Poland.
NOTE: It can also be found in many other European countries.
text_zh: 在波蘭很少能找到黑色的第 4 代 Google 車。
注意：它也可以在許多其他歐洲國家找到。

text: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Poland.
NOTE: It can also be found in other European countries.
text_zh: 在波蘭也很少能找到白色的第 4 代 Google 車。
注意：這也可以在其他歐洲國家找到。

text: The Generation 3 Street View car found in Puerto Rico has an **antenna** at the front right. The antenna has a small white dot on the tip.
NOTE: The Google car on Guam and NMI also have an antenna at the front right. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
