text_zh: Puerto Rico 的第 3 相機世代 Google 車在右前方有一根**天線**。天線頂端有一個小白點。
注意：Guam 和 NMI 的 Google 車在右前方也有一根天線。在猜測之前，請務必留意其他線索。

text: The Google car will usually be **blurred**, with only the **antenna on the left and** a sliver of the car visible. Sometimes the entire **white pickup truck** can be visible. Rusty clips can be seen on the crossbar.
_See the region guessing section for more information._
text_zh: Google 車通常會被 **模糊處理**，僅露出 **左側的天線** 和一小部分的車輛。有時整輛 **白色皮卡車** 都清晰可見。橫桿上可以看到生鏽的夾子。
_請參閱地區猜測章節以了解更多資訊。_

text: Réunion has a Street View car with visible side mirrors, a roof rack, and **black tape** at the end of the **rear right bar**.
NOTE: Make sure not to get this confused with the Ghana car, which has tape on the front right bar.
text_zh: 留尼旺的 Google 車具有清晰可見的車外後視鏡、車頂架，且**右後桿**的末端貼有**黑色膠帶**。
注意：請確保不要將其與迦納的 Google 車搞混，迦納的車是在前右桿上貼有膠帶。

text: Only a handful of roads were covered without a trekker. Learning the general regions with coverage will help you get those extra 10 points.
text_zh: 只有少數道路沒有使用徒步拍攝覆蓋。了解有覆蓋的通用區域將有助於你獲得那額外 10 分。

text: A **boat trekker**, with a green boat, can be found in the far east of the country. It mostly goes through small, overgrown canals in a flat landscape.
NOTE: There is no road coverage in this region.
text_zh: 一艘綠色的**船隻徒步拍攝**可以在該國最東端找到。它主要穿過平坦景觀中長滿雜草的小運河。
注意：此區域沒有道路覆蓋。

text: All coverage was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker camera**.
text_zh: 所有街景覆蓋都是用 **Generation 3 徒步拍攝相機**拍攝的。

text: Saint-Pierre is the capital and largest town. The coverage in this town is made with a **sidewalk trekker**. Larger buildings and more cars can be seen, with a more populated feel compared to Miquelon-Langlade.
text_zh: 聖皮耶是首都與最大城鎮。此城鎮的街景覆蓋是使用**人行道徒步拍攝**拍攝的。相較於密克隆與朗格德，這裡可以看到較大的建築物和較多車輛，給人更熱鬧的感覺。

text: This rural trekker in the far north can be recognized by the **rolling, grassy** landscape. The trekker can also be seen walking on a wooden path, with trees on either side.
text_zh: 這個位於極北處的鄉村徒步拍攝可以透過**起伏、長滿草**的景觀來辨識。也可以看到徒步拍攝走在木棧道上，兩側都有樹木。

text: The rural trekker on Saint Pierre island has a more **rocky** landscape. The trekker also walks on a path with trees on both sides.
text_zh: 聖皮耶島上的鄉村徒步拍攝具有較多**岩石**的景觀。徒步拍攝也走在兩側有樹木的小徑上。

text: This **boat** **trekker** between Saint Pierre Island and Île-aux-Marins can be recognized by this man wearing a grey and black sweater.
text_zh: 這個位於聖皮耶島與聖保祿島之間的**船隻** **徒步拍攝**可以透過這名穿著灰黑色毛衣的男子來辨識。

text: The **historic centre** is covered by a Generation 3 trekker camera.
text_zh: **歷史中心**由第三代徒步拍攝相機所覆蓋。

text: A Google Car with a visible **roof rack** and the right side mirror is seen in Generation 3 coverage. **Rifts** can also be seen in the sky.
NOTE: This specific Google Car with the right side mirror visible is unique to Senegal. Roof racks and rifts however can be seen in various other countries.
text_zh: 在第 3 代相機世代的街景中可以看到一台看得見**車頂架**與右側後視鏡的 Google 車。天空中也可以看到**接圖裂縫**。
注意：這台看得見右側後視鏡的特定 Google 車是塞內加爾特有的。不過車頂架和接圖裂縫在其他許多國家也能看到。

text: Diourbel Region is the only region in Senegal with extensive **rural coverage**. The coverage in the region will look like this, with the Google Car driving on a sandy road with sparse trees. Some of the coverage extends to the west in the Thies region up to Babou.
NOTE: The sand in the coverage around Touba tends to be more [grassy](https://goo.gl/maps/BWCDdy4HBumDShTx9).
text_zh: 迪烏爾貝勒區（Diourbel Region）是塞內加爾唯一擁有廣泛**鄉村覆蓋**的地區。該地區的覆蓋看起來會像這樣，Google 車行駛在長有稀疏樹木的沙路上一部分覆蓋延伸到了西邊的捷斯地區，一直到巴布（Babou）。
注意：圖巴（Touba）周邊街景中的沙子往往[草木較多](https://goo.gl/maps/BWCDdy4HBumDShTx9)。

text: The Generation 3 **trekker on Pulau Ubin** can be identified by the unusually rural forest coverage and the camouflage-type hat sometimes visible when looking down.
text_zh: 烏敏島（Pulau Ubin）上的第 3 代**徒步拍攝**可以透過異常鄉村化的森林覆蓋，以及向下看時有時可見的迷彩帽來識別。

text: You can recognise **St John and Lazarus Islands** thanks to the Generation 3 trekker, the smooth asphalt roads and the sea almost always nearby.
text_zh: 你可以透過第 3 代徒步拍攝、平坦的柏油路以及幾乎隨時在側的大海，來認出**聖約翰島和拉撒路島**。

text: A black generation 4 Google car can also be found in both Slovakia and Czechia.
NOTE: A black car can be found in many other European countries too.
text_zh: 在斯洛伐克和捷克也能找到黑色的第 4 代 Google 車。
注意：許多其他歐洲國家也能找到黑色的車。

text: A red generation 4 Google car can be found in both Slovakia and Czechia.
NOTE: A red car can be found in other European countries too.
text_zh: 在斯洛伐克和捷克也能找到紅色的第 4 代 Google 車。
注意：其他歐洲國家也能找到紅色的車。

text: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Slovenia.
NOTE: It can also be found in other European countries.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞也偶爾能找到白色的第四代 Google 車。
注意：這也可以在其他歐洲國家找到。

text: **Generation 2 coverage** is quite common in the country.
It can be recognized by the large circular car blur and the halo-like colour distortion in the sky.
NOTE: On the continent of Africa, Generation 2 is only found in South Africa.
text_zh: **第二代街景覆蓋**在該國相當常見。
其特徵是大型圓形車輛模糊影像以及天空中的暈環狀色彩失真。
註：在非洲大陸上，第二代街景僅見於南非。

text: A **camouflage **car with black side mirrors and roof racks can be seen in Kruger National Park, on the Mozambique border.
NOTE: The Park now also has generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: 在莫三比克邊境的克魯格國家公園內，可以看到一台黑色的車側後照鏡和車頂架的**迷彩 **車。
注意：該公園現在也有第 4 代街景覆蓋。

text: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands are a British Overseas Territory east of the Falkland Islands. As such, for country streaks purposes, they are counted as the UK.
Coverage is very limited: there are only a couple of Generation 3 trekkers:
- One trekker in the abandoned town of Grytviken
- Three trekkers in the isolated fjords of the rest of the island.

Due to the sparse nature of the coverage, that is also entirely not on any streets, it is not useful to learn any territory identification metas. Instead, it is better to just memorise what the trekkers look like.
text_zh: 南喬治亞與南桑威奇群島是位於福克蘭群島以東的英國海外領地。因此，就國家連勝（streak）記錄而言，它們被算作英國。
街景覆蓋非常有限：只有少數幾個第 3 代徒步拍攝：
- 一個在廢棄城鎮格里特維肯的徒步拍攝
- 三個在島嶼其餘部分孤立峽灣中的徒步拍攝。
由於覆蓋範圍稀疏，且完全不在任何街道上，因此學習任何領土識別特徵（meta）並沒有什麼用處。相反地，直接記住徒步拍攝的外觀會更好。

text: Abandoned, **rusted machinery** can be seen in Grytviken.
Grytviken is the only pinpointable trekker in South Georgia. Therefore, this trekker appears in pinpointable maps like [A Community World](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914).
text_zh: 在格里特維肯可以看到廢棄的**生鏽機械**。
格里威肯（Grytviken）是南喬治亞島唯一可精準定位的徒步拍攝地點。因此，這個徒步拍攝會出現在諸如[A Community World](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914)等可精準定位的地圖中。

text: This **boat trekker** in Hercules Bay can be recognized by a man in a red jacket and the MS National Geographic Explorer in the background.
text_zh: 海格力斯灣的這個**船隻徒步拍攝**可以透過一名穿著紅夾克男子以及背景中的國家地理探險家號（MS National Geographic Explorer）來辨識。

text: Almost all road coverage in South Korea is made with a **Generation 3** camera.
In most, but not all, of the coverage, the back of the Google car is visible. You can see three colours: **black, white** and **silver**. The car never has an antenna.
text_zh: 南韓幾乎所有的道路覆蓋都是用**第 3 代**相機拍攝的。
在絕大多數（但非全部）的覆蓋中，可以看到 Google 車的車尾。你可以看到三種顏色：**黑色、白色**和**銀色**。這輛車從來沒有天線。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Spain. This camera is known as the **official Ari** (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur, and can be distinguished from Generation 2 by its lack of a sky halo and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
text_zh: Google 在西班牙使用過一款奇怪且畫質低劣的相機。這款相機被稱為**官方 Ari**（或「糞便相機 Shitcam」）。它有一個寬大的圓形車輛模糊遮罩，且因為缺乏天空暈光（halo）且通常帶有微紅褐色，可以與第 2 代相機區分開來。好的地圖通常不會包含這種街景，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。

text: In most Generation 3 coverage, you will be able to see the **front of the Google car** partially through the blur: it is visible as blue-white-red patches, reminiscent of the French flag. The red patch is usually most visually distinct.
NOTE: This car is unique to Sri Lanka. Coverage in Ghana has a similar front of the car visible, but this coverage also has a roof rack.
text_zh: 在大多數第三代街景中，你將能夠透過模糊效果部分看到 **Google 車的前方**：它顯示為藍-白-紅色的色塊，讓人聯想起法國國旗。紅色色塊通常在視覺上最為明顯。
注意：這輛車是斯里蘭卡特有的。迦納的街景也有類似可見的車頭，但該街景還帶有車頂架。

text: All Generation 4 coverage is **low-cam**. This means that the camera on the Google car is intentionally set up lower than in most other countries. This can be recognized in two ways:
- The car blur is significantly bigger. Generally, the bigger car blur is the most consistent way to recognize low-cam.
- Roads look wider and objects around you are seen from a lower angle.
Note that Sri Lanka’s Generation 3 coverage is made with a normal height camera!
NOTE: All coverage in Japan and Switzerland is low-cam. However, landscape should be sufficient to tell these apart from Sri Lanka.
text_zh: 所有第四代街景都是 **低相機視角（low-cam）**。這意味著 Google 車上的相機故意設置得比大多數其他國家還要低。這可以透過兩種方式辨識：
- 車輛模糊範圍明顯更大。通常，較大的車輛模糊是辨識低相機視角最一致的方法。
- 道路看起來更寬，你周圍的物體是以更低的視角被看見。
請注意，斯里蘭卡的第三代街景是用正常高度的相機拍攝的！
注意：日本和瑞士的所有街景都是低相機視角。然而，地景應該足以將它們與斯里蘭卡區分開來。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Sri Lanka. This camera is known as the official Ari (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Other tropical countries with shitcam include India, Cambodia, Ecuador and to a lesser extent Bangladesh.
text_zh: Google 在斯里蘭卡使用了一個奇怪且低品質的相機。這款相機被稱為官方的 Ari（或「爛相機／Shitcam」）。它有著寬大的圓形車輛模糊，且顏色通常有點偏棕色。優秀的地圖通常不會包含這種街景，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。
注意：其他擁有爛相機的熱帶國家包括印度、柬埔寨、厄瓜多，以及程度較輕的孟加拉。

text: A trekker can be seen holding on to a **red car** heading up a winding road, south of the Svalbard Airport. If the car is not present, this distinct [line of mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/Aub5RxFwVD9QruVz9) to the northeast is a good indicator that you are there.
text_zh: 在斯瓦爾巴機場南方，可以看到一台徒步拍攝相機正抓著一台開往蜿蜒山路的**紅色車**。如果沒有看到車子，東北方這個明顯的[山脈稜線](https://goo.gl/maps/Aub5RxFwVD9QruVz9)會是判斷你身處該處的好指標。

text: Small **red crosses** marking snowmobile trails can be found throughout the northern half of the country.
text_zh: 標記雪地摩托車道的小型**紅色十字**標誌遍佈全國北部地區。

text: Along the Swedish west coast, and in Skåne, you may find a white Google car with a **blue stripe** on the back.
NOTE: This car is almost never found outside of Sweden.
text_zh: 沿著瑞典西海岸以及斯堪ane，你可能會發現一台背面有**藍色條紋**的白色 Google 車。
注意：這台車幾乎不會在瑞典境外出現。

text: By far the most important way to recognize Switzerland, is that all car coverage is **low-cam**. This means that the camera on the Google car is intentionally set up lower than in most other countries. This can be recognized in two ways:
- The car blur is significantly bigger.
- Roads look wider and objects around you are seen from a lower angle.
Generally, the bigger car blur is the most consistent way to recognize low-cam.

NOTE: The only other countries that always have low-cam are [Japan](https://www.google.com/maps/@35.8415638,139.9145236,3a,75y,305.11h,83.84t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D33.088177%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192) and [Liechtenstein](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jn7cXhtXQRG6Hd9a6).
text_zh: 識別瑞士迄今為止最重要的方法是，所有汽車街景覆蓋都是**低角度相機（low-cam）**。這意味著 Google 車上的相機故意設定得比大多數其他國家都要低。這可以透過兩種方式識別：
- 車影模糊範圍明顯更大。
- 道路看起來更寬，你周圍的物體是以更低的視角被看見。
通常來說，較大的車影模糊是辨識低相機視角最一致的方法。

注意：唯一其他總是使用低角度相機的國家是[日本](https://www.google.com/maps/@35.8415638,139.9145236,3a,75y,305.11h,83.84t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D33.088177%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)和[列支敦斯登](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jn7cXhtXQRG6Hd9a6)。

text: Tanzania has **extremely limited coverage**:
- Several Generation 3 trekkers in Gombe National Park. There is also one small indoor tripod in this park.
- A couple of tripods on Mount Kilimanjaro.
- Some spill coverage, made with a regular Google car, on the border with Kenya.
This guide only discusses the trekkers and tripods. For the spills, see our [spillover guide](/spillover-countries).

It should be noted that none of the trekkers and tripods are pinpointable, or even on a road, and therefore they typically do not appear in serious competitive maps. This guide describes them primarily for the sake of completeness. The spills however do appear in maps from time to time.

Due to the sparse nature of the coverage, that is also entirely not on any streets, it is not useful to learn any territory identification metas. Instead, it is better to just memorise what the trekkers and tripods look like.
text_zh: 坦尚尼亞的**街景覆蓋極為有限**：
- 貢貝國家公園內有幾個第三代（Generation 3）徒步拍攝（trekker）。此公園內還有一個小型室內三腳架拍攝點。
- 吉力馬札羅山上有一對三腳架拍攝點。
- 在與肯亞的邊界上有少量由一般 Google 車拍攝的溢出覆蓋（spill coverage）。
本指南僅討論徒步拍攝與三腳架拍攝。至於溢出覆蓋，請參見我們的[溢出國家指南](/spillover-countries)。
必須指出的是，這些徒步拍攝與三腳架拍攝點皆無法精確定位，甚至不在道路上，因此通常不會出現在嚴格的競賽地圖中。本指南介紹它們主要是為了完整性。不過，溢出覆蓋確實會不時出現在地圖中。
由於街景覆蓋稀疏，且完全不在任何街道上，學習任何領地識別線索特徵（meta）並沒有太大用處。相反地，直接記住徒步拍攝與三腳架拍攝長什麼樣子會是更好的做法。

text: A walking trekker goes through a large part of Gombe National Park. The landscape varies somewhat from place to place.
In the lowland parts, you will see **dense jungle** and usually very little sunlight, leading to dark coverage. Sometimes, you can see **chimpanzees**.
text_zh: 徒步拍攝者走過了貢貝國家公園的大部分地區。當地的景觀隨地點不同而有些許變化。
在低地地區，你會看到**茂密的叢林**，通常陽光很少，導致街景偏暗。有時，你可以看到**黑猩猩**。

text: There is a **boat trekker** in Lake Tanganyika, that hugs the coast very closely, next to Gombe National Park. The coast is always to your east. You will see hills that are mostly covered in tropical forest, with some bare and grassy hilltops.
You can see the boat through the blur: it is painted **olive green and white**, and has some people in it. The boat and people are always pixelated due to the blur.
NOTE: Do not confuse this boat trekker with the [boats in Madagascar](https://www.plonkit.net/madagascar#3).
text_zh: 在坦干依喀湖中緊貼著海岸、鄰近貢貝國家公園的地方，有一個**船隻徒步拍攝**（boat trekker）。海岸始終位於你的東側。你會看到主要被熱帶森林覆蓋的山丘，伴隨著一些光禿和長滿草的山頂。
你可以透過模糊效果看到這艘船：它被漆成**橄欖綠與白色**，上面有一些人。由於模糊效果，船隻和人員總是呈現像素化的狀態。
註：切勿將此船隻徒步拍攝與[馬達加斯加的船隻](https://www.plonkit.net/madagascar#3)搞混。

text: There is one more tripod in Tanzania, inside [Jane Goodall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane_Goodall)’s house. It is also located in Gombe National Park, adjacent to the normal Generation 3 trekker coverage.
text_zh: 坦尚尼亞還有另一個三腳架拍攝點，位於[珍·古德](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane_Goodall)的故居內。它同樣位於貢貝國家公園內，鄰近一般的第三代徒步拍攝覆蓋。

text: This rare Google car with a **visible mirror** is only found in far southern Thailand.
NOTE: Due to most of the coverage being overwritten by new Generation 4, this car is rarely seen.
text_zh: 這輛帶有**可見後視鏡**的稀有 Google 車僅在泰國極南部找到。
注意：由於大部分街景覆蓋已被第四代新相機覆蓋，這輛車很少見。

text: This rare Google car is only found on the island of Ko Sichang. It is recognizable due to the **bar(s) protruding out of the blur**.
text_zh: 這輛稀有的 Google 車僅在西昌島（Ko Sichang）上找到。它的可識別之處在於**凸出模糊效果的桿子**。

text: One of the best ways to recognize Tunisia is that, in most coverage, the Google car is escorted by a **follow car**.
There are several different follow cars and these are four of the most commonly found ones.
NOTE: Follow cars can be in front of the street view car, or very far behind. Make sure to pan and zoom if you do not find them immediately.
text_zh: 辨識突尼西亞最好的方法之一是，在大多數街景中，Google 車都有**跟拍車**護衛。
有幾種不同的跟拍車，這是其中最常見的四種。
注意：跟拍車可能在街景車前方，或在非常後方。如果你沒有立即找到牠們，請記得平移和縮放。

text: The Google car in Tunisia is **black** with a medium-length, thin antenna.
NOTE: The colour of the car is not always perceptible. Make sure to look around for other more helpful clues.
text_zh: 突尼西亞的 Google 車是**黑色**的，配有中等長度的細天線。
注意：車子的顏色並不一定總是看得清楚。請務必環顧四周尋找其他更有幫助的線索。

text: In the **Generation 3** coverage, the Google car **never has an antenna**.
text_zh: 在**第 3 代**街景覆蓋中，Google 車**絕不會有天線**。

text: The **Generation 4** coverage in Turkey typically features a **white Google car**. Usually, only a tiny sliver of the back of the car is visible. The car can have a short antenna, or [no antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/cDZNhkcAjdTX5zw89) at all.
text_zh: 土耳其的**第 4 代**街景覆蓋通常配備**白色 Google 車**。通常只能看到車尾的一小截邊緣。這輛車可能裝有短天線，或[完全沒有天線](https://goo.gl/maps/cDZNhkcAjdTX5zw89)。

text: The islands other than the Midway Atoll can generally be characterised by three things. Firstly, the **Generation 3 trekker** coverage. Secondly, the low, **bushy** vegetation, and thirdly, the presence of numerous **birds**.
text_zh: 除了中途島之外，其他島嶼通常可以用三件事來特徵化。首先是**第三代徒步拍攝**街景。其次是低矮、**多叢的**植被，第三則是存在著大量的**鳥類**。

text: The United States Virgin Islands features 3 unique Google cars. The first of which is shown here. This red truck with a **red cab** can only be seen in the southern island of St Croix. This is the **most common** car that will be seen as St Croix has the most coverage.
text_zh: 美屬維京群島有 3 種獨特的 Google 車。其中第一種如這裡所示。這輛帶有**紅色車頭**的紅色卡車只能在南部的聖克魯斯島看到。這是**最常見**會看到的車輛，因為聖克魯斯島的街景最多。

text: Two **boat trekkers** are found on the north coast of St Croix. The boat cannot be seen, however the trekker can be identified by the blue waters and hilly islands. The area near Buck Island National Park also has a distinct [pink tint](https://goo.gl/maps/kiRppxZK9vQVe3FA7) to the camera.
text_zh: 在聖克魯斯島的北海岸可以找到兩艘**船隻徒步拍攝**。看不見船本身，但可以透過湛藍的海水和多山的小島來辨識徒步拍攝街景。巴克島國家紀念公園（Buck Island National Park）附近的相機也帶有明顯的[粉紅色調](https://goo.gl/maps/kiRppxZK9vQVe3FA7)。

text: In all coverage in Kampala, a unique Google car is visible. This car is **white** with **square **side mirrors and a boxy look.
NOTE: This Google car is only found in Uganda and is unique to the city of Kampala and its outskirts.
text_zh: 在坎帕拉的所有街景中，都可以看到一台獨特的 Google 車。這台車是 **白色** 的，配有 **方形** 車外後視鏡且外形方正。
註：這台 Google 車僅見於烏干達，且為坎帕拉市及其市郊所獨有。

text: Throughout Kampala, you will often see these **taxi buses**, with a blue blocky pattern on the sides. These are a good clue for the city if you are not able to see the Google car.
text_zh: 在整個坎帕拉，你經常會看到這些側邊帶有藍色塊狀圖案的 **計程車小巴**。如果你看不到 Google 車，這些是識別該市的好線索。

text: All coverage in Ukraine is Generation 3. Most of it was made using a **red Google car**. This car is almost unique to Ukraine. It sometimes has an antenna, and sometimes no antenna. Note that the car is not always visible, though at times you will still be able to tell its colour due to the [car blur glitch](https://goo.gl/maps/9Lu9tCUzdXBZahdW7).
NOTE: The car meta can be very useful to tell Ukraine and Russia apart:
- Most importantly, you will not find the red Generation 3 car in Russia.
- Russia can have Generation 4 (and sometimes Generation 2). Ukraine never has either Generation.
- Russian Generation 3 cars always have either a short or long antenna. If you see no antenna at all, consider Ukraine.
Also note that some parts of Belgium can have a red google car with a long antenna.
text_zh: 烏干達的所有街景覆蓋皆為第三代（Gen 3）。大部分都是用一台**紅色 Google 車**拍攝的。這台車在烏干達幾乎是獨一無二的。它有時有天線，有時則沒有天線。請注意，車輛不一定隨時可見，但有時你仍能透過[車輛模糊瑕疵](https://goo.gl/maps/9Lu9tCUzdXBZahdW7)看出它的顏色。
備註：車輛 meta 對於分辨烏克蘭與俄羅斯非常有用：
- 最重要的一點是，你在俄羅斯找不到紅色的 Generation 3 車。
- 俄羅斯可能有 Generation 4（有時也有 Generation 2）。烏克蘭則完全沒有這兩種世代。
- 俄羅斯的 Generation 3 車一定配有短天線或長天線。如果你完全沒看到天線，請考慮烏克蘭。
另請注意，比利時的部分地區可能會出現帶有長天線的紅色 Google 車。

text: More rarely, you can also find several other Google cars in Ukraine:
- [Black car with a long antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/R1LpZodEBBraGPKT6)
- [White car with a long antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/u5fAxwRop4cbLk1z5)
- [Grey car with a short antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/d5WUGjcMKhT9YqL66)
These cars can be found in multiple countries, including Russia. See the region guessing section to see where you can find these cars within Ukraine.
text_zh: 更罕見的是，你也可以在烏克蘭找到其他幾種 Google 車：
- [帶長天線的黑車](https://goo.gl/maps/R1LpZodEBBraGPKT6)
- [帶長天線的白車](https://goo.gl/maps/u5fAxwRop4cbLk1z5)
- [帶短天線的灰車](https://goo.gl/maps/d5WUGjcMKhT9YqL66)
這些車輛可能會在多個國家出現，包括俄羅斯。請參閱區域猜測章節，了解如何在烏克蘭國內找到這些車輛。

text: This older 2011 coverage was made with a **black or white Google car**, instead of the standard red one. Both cars have a long antenna.
The [black car](https://goo.gl/maps/5f74GEbvVoWHJbFn9) was used in Donetsk. Note that Donetsk has no newer coverage whatsoever, so never guess in that city if you see a red car.
The [white car](https://goo.gl/maps/u46paGk3UKYZLBor7) was used in Lviv, Kyiv and Kharkiv. As the coverage in these cities is mostly overwritten, the white car is very rare.
text_zh: 這項較舊的 2011 年覆蓋是用**黑色或白色的 Google 車**拍攝的，而不是標準的紅色車。兩輛車都配有長天線。
[黑車](https://goo.gl/maps/5f74GEbvVoWHJbFn9)用於頓內次克。請注意，頓內次克沒有任何較新的覆蓋，所以如果你看到紅車，絕對不要猜那座城市。
[白車](https://goo.gl/maps/u46paGk3UKYZLBor7)用於利維夫、基輔和哈爾科夫。由於這些城市的覆蓋大多已被覆蓋，因此白車非常罕見。

text: A **leaf** can be seen on the back of the Google car from: Ternopil to Zolochiv on the H02, Ternopil to Brody on the P39, and from Brody to Dubno on the E40. It can also be seen from Brody to Pochaiv on the P26 and from Dubno to Mlyniv on the E85.
text_zh: 一片**樹葉**可以在以下地點的 Google 車背面看到：H02 公路上的捷爾諾波爾至佐洛奇夫路段、P39 公路上的捷爾諾波爾至布羅迪路段，以及 E40 公路上的布羅迪至杜布諾路段。在 P26 公路上的布羅迪至波恰伊夫路段以及 E85 公路上的杜布諾至姆利尼夫路段也能看到。

text: Google sent a special car trekker to the [Chernobyl Exclusion Zone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chernobyl_Exclusion_Zone), where the nuclear disaster happened in the 1980s. This car goes from Ivankiv all the way to the **abandoned town** of Pripyat.

On most of the road to Pripyat, you will not really be able to tell that you are inside the Exclusion Zone. However, inside Pripyat you will see completely abandoned and overgrown buildings, giving the place an eerie look.
text_zh: Google 派出一輛特殊的跟拍車前往發生於 1980 年代核災的[車諾比禁區](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chernobyl_Exclusion_Zone)。這輛車從伊萬科夫一路開到**廢棄城鎮**普里皮亞特。
在通往普里皮亞特的絕大多數道路上，你其實不會感覺自己身處禁區內。然而，在普里皮亞特內部，你會看到完全荒廢且雜草叢生的建築物，給這個地方一種詭異的外觀。

text: On one side of the road going to Chernobyl, a **yellow flag with an Opel logo** can be seen on the Google car’s antenna.
text_zh: 在通往車諾比的道路的一側，可以在 Google 車的天線上看到一面**印有歐寶標誌的黃色旗標**。

text: In almost all Generation 3 coverage, a **white car** with visible black roof racks was used.
NOTE: The UAE is the only Middle Eastern country where a white Google car can be found.
text_zh: 在幾乎所有的 Generation 3 覆蓋中，使用了一輛帶有明顯黑色車頂架的**白車**。
備註：阿拉伯聯合大公國是唯一能找到白色 Google 車的中東國家。

text: In Generation 4 coverage, a white **pickup truck** with a trekker camera was used for much of the coverage. In a lot of the coverage, the truck is completely [blurred out](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gz9p2N59bhqFxtvT7).

NOTE: A similar truck can be found in [Qatar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9vAjK8jA8Upvm1pq8) and [Oman](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CAfekUi6QZ6TF6bV7). In the UAE the antenna at the front of the cabin is on the middle of the car, while in Qatar it is on the left.
text_zh: 在 Generation 4 覆蓋中，大部分覆蓋使用了一輛裝有徒步拍攝相機的白色**皮卡車**。在許多覆蓋中，這輛卡車被完全[模糊處理](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gz9p2N59bhqFxtvT7)。
備註：類似的卡車可以在[卡達](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9vAjK8jA8Upvm1pq8)和[阿曼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CAfekUi6QZ6TF6bV7)找到。在阿拉伯聯合大公國，車廂前方的天線位於車子正中央，而在卡達則位於左側。

text: Coverage in the UAE is mostly limited to the **Northeastern part** of the country.
NOTE: The only car coverage outside of this region exists on Sir Baniyas Island. All other remote coverage was taken by a trekker.
text_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國的街景覆蓋大多限於該國的**東北部**。
注意：該區域外唯一的車輛街景覆蓋存在於薩爾巴尼亞斯島（Sir Baniyas Island）。所有其他偏遠覆蓋都是由徒步拍攝拍的。

text: This rare white Google car with visible side mirrors and sparse vegetation is found on **Sir Baniyas** Island.
text_zh: 這輛罕見的白色 Google 車帶有明顯的側視鏡且植被稀疏，出現在**薩爾巴尼亞斯**島（Sir Baniyas）。

text: In some parts of Dubai, including the [old town](https://goo.gl/maps/CXsP5xq4fAtX7Ds47), a Generation 4 **sidewalk trekker** was used. Sometimes, the employee’s black hair is visible.
text_zh: 在杜拜的某些地區，包括[老城區](https://goo.gl/maps/CXsP5xq4fAtX7Ds47)，使用了第 4 代**人行道徒步拍攝**。有時可以看到員工的黑髮。

text: The main island of Dry Tortugas National Park, west of Key West, can be identified by the **hexagonal brick structure** and the surrounding moat.

The Loggerhead Lighthouse, situated on the Loggerhead Key, has a brown top-half and a white bottom. The path on which the trekker walks on is also made of bright concrete, and many palm trees can be seen around the lighthouse.
text_zh: 位於基韋斯特（Key West）西側的乾龜群島國家公園（Dry Tortugas National Park）主島，可以透過 **六角形磚造結構** 以及周圍的護城河來辨識。
位於 Loggerhead Key 的 Loggerhead Lighthouse，其燈塔上半部為棕色，下半部為白色。拍攝用的徒步拍攝所行走的步道也是由明亮的混凝土製成，燈塔周圍可以看到許多棕櫚樹。

text: Uruguay only has Generation 3 coverage. Coverage was taken by a **black Google car** without an antenna.
The car is [not always visible](https://goo.gl/maps/KnYb3vpU7r7n6sKi8).
NOTE: Within South America, you can also find this car in Argentina and Peru.
text_zh: 烏拉圭只有第 3 代街景覆蓋。街景是由沒有天線的**黑色 Google 車**所拍攝。
這輛車[不一定隨時可見](https://goo.gl/maps/KnYb3vpU7r7n6sKi8)。
注意：在南美洲境內，你也可以在阿根廷和祕魯找到這輛車。

text: The small island of **Isla de Flores** is located off the coast of Montevideo. It has a trekker where you can see abandoned buildings, and usually also the lighthouse.
text_zh: 小島**弗洛雷斯島**（Isla de Flores）位於蒙特維的亞海岸外。這裡有徒步拍攝街景，你可以看到廢棄建築，通常還能看到燈塔。

text: This unique Google car is found in the coastal town of **Cabo Polonio**. It can be recognized by the orange strap on the left.

The coverage is an off-road trekker line on the map. The town that it drives through has a unique vibe, consisting of [makeshift-looking shacks](https://goo.gl/maps/kFRyFRU2vKYk4qUc6), scattered around the seaside landscape. In some of the coverage, the car drives [on the beach](https://goo.gl/maps/TcgFWK775WANzTax8).
text_zh: 這個獨特的 Google 車可在海濱小鎮**卡波波洛尼奧**（Cabo Polonio）找到。它可以透過左側的橘色帶子來辨識。
這段街景是地圖上的越野徒步拍攝路線。它穿過的小鎮有著獨特的氛圍，由散落海濱景觀各處的[臨時搭建棚屋](https://goo.gl/maps/kFRyFRU2vKYk4qUc6)組成。在部分街景中，Google 車是開[在沙灘上](https://goo.gl/maps/TcgFWK775WANzTax8)。

text: This unique Google car is found in the **Valle del Lunarejo** natural park, located west of the town of Tranqueras. The car has a white front and a curved black backside with a brown strap.
The coverage is an off-road trekker line on the map. The car drives on a small track through a [grassy landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/uBVaJPJwiV9Ks2UX6).
NOTE: This park only shows up as a point of interest on the map, instead of the usual dark green polygon used for natural parks.
text_zh: 這個獨特的 Google 車可在**盧納雷霍谷**（Valle del Lunarejo）自然公園找到，位於特蘭克拉斯鎮的西側。這台車有著白色的車頭，以及帶有棕色帶子的彎曲黑色車尾。
這段街景是地圖上的越野徒步拍攝路線。Google 車行駛在一條穿過[草地景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/uBVaJPJwiV9Ks2UX6)的小徑上。
注意：這個公園在地圖上僅顯示為一個興趣點，而不是自然公園通常使用的深綠色多邊形。

text: All coverage in Vanuatu was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker**.
text_zh: 萬那杜的所有街景都是用**第三代徒步拍攝**所拍攝的。

text: This unique **volcano** trekker can be found in the middle of the island.
text_zh: 這個獨特的**火山**徒步拍攝可以在島嶼中間找到。

text: Tropical plants and many **ferns** can be seen in this jungle further to the east. A man with a **red cap** is also seen with the trekker.
text_zh: 再往東的這個叢林中可以看到熱帶植物和許多**蕨類植物**。徒步拍攝中也可以看到一個戴著**紅色帽子**的男子。

text: Vietnam has a fair amount of **motorcycle coverage**. This can be recognized by the unique shape of the car blur, which vaguely resembles the shape of a bone, and extends slightly higher up on one side. Sometimes you will only see the [helmet of the motorcyclist](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Md2n5vSVD72w2y197).
There is both Generation 3 and [Generation 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/C1gwqT4kMgTz54pE6) motorcycle coverage.
Vietnam has by far the most motorcycle coverage in the world. In particular, if you see this type of coverage in a rural place, you are almost guaranteed to be in Vietnam.
text_zh: 越南有相當數量的**機車街景覆蓋**。這可以透過車輛模糊處理的獨特形狀來識別，其形狀隱約類似一塊骨頭，且在一側稍微延伸得更高。有時你只會看到[機車騎士的安全帽](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Md2n5vSVD72w2y197)。
這裡同時有第 3 代和[第 4 代](https://maps.app.goo.gl/C1gwqT4kMgTz54pE6)的機車街景覆蓋。
越南是目前世界上機車街景覆蓋最多的國家。特別是，如果你在鄉村地區看到這種街景，幾乎百分之百可以確定身在越南。

text: **Shitcam** can be found in some areas of Vietnam. Notably, the shitcam coverage has a car blur similar to the one from the previous tip, which makes it distinct from other countries where shitcam usually has a larger and more circular blur.
NOTE: The areas in which shitcam can be found will be discussed further at the end of step 2.
text_zh: **爛相機（Shitcam）**可以在越南的一些地區找到。值得注意的是，爛相機的車輛模糊形狀與前一個小提示中的類似，這使它與其他國家（那裡的爛相機通常具有更大且更圓的模糊效果）有所區別。
注意：可以找到 shitcam 的區域將會在步驟 2 的結尾進一步討論。

intro.lead: 看得到車體就等於半個答案，顏色與天線是關鍵
body: Google 街景車在許多國家有固定的車體顏色、車頂配置與天線形狀，往下看就能在畫面底部看到。這是最可靠的線索之一，因為它不受季節與地區差異影響。
看四件事：車體顏色（白、黑、銀，或印度的黑白相間）、有沒有天線與天線長短、車頂行李架的形狀、以及模糊處理的範圍大小。某些國家整台車被模糊成一團，那本身就是特徵。
